gloss.intro: Ngā kupu e whakamahia ana e ngā kaiwhakawhanake (me ngā rōpū AI), i te reo māmā.
gloss.none: Kāore he kupu e hāngai ana.
gloss.switch.help: Ka puta he whakamārama māmā mō ngā kupu he rārangi ira kei raro, ina whakatau koe i te pere ki runga.
gloss.backlog.text: Te rārangi tatari o ngā whakaaro me ngā mahi kāore anō kia whakaritea, kei runga te mea nui rawa. Kāore he mea o reira e mahia kia neke rā anō ki Hei mahi.
gloss.sprint.text: He wā poto, kua whakaritea, o te mahi (te nuinga he wiki, e rua wiki rānei, kāore e neke atu i te marama kotahi), he whāinga tōna, he huinga kāri kua whakaaetia hei whakaoti.
gloss.standup.also: standup,stand-ups,daily scrum,daily stand-up,hui tū ia rā
gloss.standup.text: He whakapā tere ia rā: he aha te mahi a ia mema o te rōpū, he aha tāna ka mahi ai, he aha hoki te mea e aukati ana i a ia. I Scrum e kīia ana he daily scrum.
gloss.bug.text: He mea kāore e mahi pērā i te tika.
gloss.test.text: He tirotiro mēnā e mahi ana tētahi mea i te āhua e tika ana. Ka whakahaerehia ētahi whakamātau e te rorohiko mā tōna anō i ia wā ka rerekē te waehere; ko ētahi atu ko tō whakamātau i tētahi kāri kua oti i mua i tō whakaae.
gloss.commit.text: He hopu kua tiakina o te waehere, me tētahi tuhipoka poto mō te mea i panoni. Ka taea tonu te hoki ki tētahi.
gloss.push.text: Te tuku i ō whakaahua kua penapenahia (commit) mai i tēnei rorohiko ki te tārua tiritahi ki runga ipurangi, pēnei i a GitHub, kia whai tārua ai, kia taea hoki e ētahi atu te tiki.
gloss.branch.text: He rārangi mahi motuhake i te waehere, kia taea ai ngā panonitanga me te kore e pā ki te putanga matua.
gloss.merge.text: Te whakakotahi i ngā rerekētanga mai i tētahi manga ki tētahi atu, i te nuinga o te wā ki te putanga matua.
gloss.repo.text: Te kōpaki waehere o te kaupapa me tōna hītori commit katoa. Ka noho pea ki tō rorohiko, ki GitHub, ki ngā mea e rua rānei.
gloss.refactor.text: Te whakapai i te waehere me te kore e panoni i tāna mahi: ngā kōpaki iti ake, ngā ingoa mārama ake, he iti ake te tuaruatanga.
gloss.deploy.text: Te tārua i tētahi putanga hou o te pūmanawa ki ngā rorohiko e whakahaere ana i a ia, pēnei i tētahi tārua whakamātau, i te ratonga ora rānei.
gloss.kanban.text: He tikanga mahi e neke ana ngā kāri whakawhiti i ngā pou o te papa (pēnei i Hei mahi, E mahi ana, Oti), ā, ka tepe te rōpū i te nui o te mahi e haere ana i te wā kotahi, kia rere tonu ai te mahi.
gloss.wip.text: Ko WIP te kupu poto mō work in progress (mahi e haere ana). Ko te tepe WIP te maha o ngā kāri e tika ana kia mau i tētahi pou i te wā kotahi, kia whakaoti ai te rōpū i ngā mea i mua i te tīmata i ētahi atu.
gloss.pr.text: Te tono kia tirohia, kia whakakotahitia hoki ngā rerekētanga o tētahi manga ki te putanga matua. E kīia ana e ētahi pae he merge request.
gloss.hook.text: He whakahau iti ka rere mā tōna anō i tētahi wā kua whakaritea, hei tauira ina tīmata tētahi nohoanga AI, kia rongo ai te rōpū i ō kōrero.
gloss.token.text: Ngā wāhanga kuputuhi iti e pānuitia ana, e tuhia ana e te AI, tata ki te toru hauwhā o te kupu ia wāhanga. E tatauria ana te whakamahinga AI ki ngā token, nō reira ina iti ngā token, ka toe te nui ake o tō mahere.
gloss.agent.text: He AI e mahi ana i tētahi mahi mā tōna anō: ka pānui i te waehere, ka whakarerekē, ka whakahaere i ngā tirotiro, ā, ka pūrongo mai. Ka tirohia tonutia tāna mahi.
tour.btn.title: He haerenga whakaaturanga poto o te papa
tour.intro: He ruarua ngā tauranga huri noa i te papa. Hia nui tāu e hiahia ana?
tour.lvl.new.help: Ia tauranga, me te take e pēnei ai te mahi. Ka whakamāramatia hoki ngā kupu ngaio.
tour.lvl.refresh.help: Ngā tauranga matua, kotahi te rārangi ia tauranga.
tour.welcome.title: Nau mai ki AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: He papa e mahi ai ngā rōpū AI, ā, ko koe te kaiwhakatau, te kaiwhakamātau me te kaiwhakaae. Anei te huarahi ki te kite i te wāhi.
tour.welcome.short: He tāpuku tere o te papa.
tour.welcome.why: Te whakaaro: mā ngā rōpū ngā mahi tāwai, ā, ko ngā mea anake e hiahia ana ki te tangata ka kitea e koe.
tour.rail.title: Ō kaupapa
tour.rail.text: Te kāinga, tō pouaka mai, ngā kōrerorero ki ngā kaihautū, ā, kotahi te ahua mō ia kaupapa. Ko te taimana waiporoporo e kī ana he mea e tatari ana ki a koe ki reira. Toia ngā ahua hei whakarite i tō raupapa.
tour.rail.short: Ngā kaupapa i te rēera (i raro i te pūkoro); ko ngā taimana papura te tohu e tatari ana tētahi mea ki a koe.
tour.rail.why: Mā te tiro kotahi e mōhio ai koe ki te wāhi e hiahiatia ana koe, me te kore e whakatuwhera i tētahi mea.
tour.inbox.title: Tō pouaka mai
tour.inbox.text: Ngā mea katoa e tatari ana ki a koe, puta noa i ia kaupapa: ngā pātai, ngā mahi ko koe anake e ahei, me ngā mea hei whakamātau. Pātō i tētahi pūtau hei kite i taua momo anake.
tour.inbox.short: Ngā mea katoa e tatari ana ki a koe, ahakoa kei hea. Pātō i tētahi pūtau mō tētahi momo.
tour.inbox.why: Kaua koe e haere ki ia kaupapa hei mōhio he aha te mea e hiahia ana ki a koe.
tour.foryou.title: Māu
tour.foryou.text: I runga i tētahi papa, kei tēnei pou ngā mea e tatari ana ki a koe i taua kaupapa. Whakatuwheratia tētahi whakamātautau, whaia ōna hīkoi, ka Whakaae, ka Whakahoki rānei me tētahi take.
tour.foryou.short: Te puranga mōu o tēnei kaupapa: whakamātau, ka Whakaae, ka Whakahoki rānei.
tour.foryou.why: Kāore ngā rōpū e tohu i ā rātou ake mahi kua oti: ko koe te kaiwhakaae. Nā tēnā, kei ōu ringa te kounga.
tour.chat.title: Kōrero ki ngā kaihautū
tour.chat.text: Tukuna he karere ki te kaihautū o tētahi kaupapa me tētahi whakaaro, pātai rānei. Ka huri rātou i ngā whakaaro hei kāri me tētahi mahere poto, me ngā pātene Haere mōu.
tour.chat.short: Tukua he karere ki tētahi kaihautū; ka whakamahere rātou, ka pātō koe i Haere.
tour.chat.why: Kāore he mea e hangaia kia kī koe haere: ko koe tonu te rangatira o te mea ka puta.
tour.setup.title: Tautuhinga
tour.setup.text: Tōu ingoa, tō reo, tō kaupapa me te wāhi e noho ai te AI i tēnei rorohiko. He pūhera hoki hei whakamārama i ngā kupu kaiwhakawhanake, me te kuputaka.
tour.setup.short: Ōu tautuhinga, tō reo me te kuputaka kupu hangarau. I runga i te pūkoro kei raro i te rārangi i runga.
trial.help: He kape hou, kau o AI-gile i tōna matapihi ake (localhost:4400), me ngā kaupapa pohewa e toru hei kimi, me tētahi rōpū tākaro e whakautu ana ki a koe. Kia kite pai i tā tētahi hoa e kite ai i tana rere tuatahi. Kāore tō papa tūturu e pā; kāore he AI, kāore he utu.

budget.usage.help: Ka pātai te tirotiro i te AI i tētahi pātai iti kia pānui i te whakamahinga o tō mahere, nō reira he iti te utu o ia kotahi. Mā te ringa: te pātene Tirohia te whakamahinga inaianei i te whārangi Whakamahinga. Ka tirotiro hoki te Aunoa ina neke atu i te haora te pakeke o te pānui whakamutunga. Weto: kāore he pātene, kāore he tirotiro.
budget.h5: Kaua e whakaoho i ngā rōpū i runga ake i tēnei % o te tepe 5-hāora
budget.wk: Kaua e whakaoho i ngā rōpū i runga ake i tēnei % o te tepe ia wiki
budget.help: Ka whakamahi i te pānui whakamahinga hou rawa. Ki runga ake i tētahi o ngā tau, kāore tētahi mea e tīmata (ngā rōpū, te kaitiaki pō, te kaiwhakamātau AI, ngā pātai a ngā hoa) kia heke te whakamahinga, kia tautuhi anō rānei.
budget.runs: Te nui rawa o ngā rere rōpū i te wā kotahi (0 = kāore he tepe)
budget.runs.help: Ka tatari ngā whakaoho atu i te rārangi, ā, ka tīmata ina mutu tētahi rere.
budget.helpers: Te nui rawa o ngā kaiāwhina, mō ia tauira (waiho kau = kāore he tepe)
budget.helpers.help: Ka tāpiria ki te whakamārama a te kaihautū hei ture: whakamahia te nui rawa o ngā kaiāwhina o ia tauira i te wā kotahi.
budget.pace: Tere: whāia kia oti te wiki ki te {pct}%. Mēnā e kī ana te matapae ka whiti koe i tērā i mua i te tautuhi anō, ka whakaiti te papa (kāore he kaiāwhina atu, ngā tauira iti ake) ka kōrero ki a koe kia kotahi.

dispatch.lead: Ko te kaihautū te whakatau i ngā mea katoa
dispatch.help: Ka haere ō kōrero me ngā kāri hou ki te kaihautū ki te kore koe e ingoa i tētahi (@Ingoa), ki te kore rānei he whakamātautau te kāri. Ngā ture anake e kore e karanga i tētahi AI; Ngā ture + Haiku ka pātai i te tauira iti rawa kotahi te wā ina kore e taea e ngā ture te kī; Ka whakatau te kaihautū ka whakaoho i te kaihautū i ia wā. Ka tuhia ia kōwhiringa ki te rokiroki kaupapa.
wz.btn.help: Kotahi meneti o ngā pātai e whakahāngai ana i a AI-gile ki tō tahua me tō tikanga mahi. Ka taea tonu te huri ngā mea katoa i raro.
wz.ask.sub: Pīrangi koe ki tētahi kaiārahi tere hei whakarite i ngā mea? Ka whakahāngai i a AI-gile ki tō tahua me tō tikanga mahi, ā, kotahi te meneti. Ka taea hoki e koe te kimi i tō ake huarahi.
wz.ask.yes: 🧙 Whakaritea mā te kaiārahi (e tūtohu ana)
wz.need.name: Tāpirihia tō ingoa i te tuatahi, kia mōhio ai te rōpū ki te karanga i a koe.
wz.1.sub: I AI-gile, ka mahi ngā kaiāwhina AI i ō kāri, ā, ka tirotiro koe i tā rātou i mahi ai. He ruarua noa ngā pātai tere, ā, kua rite koe. Kua tīpakohia kētia tō reo: whakarerekētia i konei mēnā he hē.
wz.2.h: Ko wai koe, ā, ko tēhea AI tāu e whakamahi ana?
wz.2.name: Tōu ingoa
wz.2.name.help: Ka karanga ō kaiāwhina AI ki a koe mā tēnei.
wz.2.agent.help: Te hōtaka AI ka tīmata e te papa ina he mahi mā ō kaiāwhina. Kāore koe i te tino mōhio? Waihotia kia kau, ā, tāpiria ā muri ake i te Tautuhinga.
wz.3.h: Me pēhea te mahi a ō kaiāwhina AI ki a koe?
wz.3.sub: Tīpakohia te mea tino tata. Ka taea e koe te whakarerekē i ia wāhanga i muri ake i te Tautuhinga.
wz.style.careful.help: Ka pātai i mua i ia hanga, quiet me te ma, ka okioki i te pō.
wz.style.balanced.help: Ka haere tonu ki ngā mea iti, he whakaoho hoa i ētahi wā, ka okioki i te pō.
wz.style.fast.help: He iti te pātai, te mahi anake, ka haere tonu i te pō.
wz.4.h: Hia nui te AI e taea e koe te whakamahi?
wz.4.sub: Mā tēnei e whakatau te nui o tō ohaurunga AI ka āhei te papa ki te whakamahi, me te maha o ngā kaupapa ka mahia i te wā kotahi. Kāore koe i te tino mōhio? Tīpakohia te Noa.
wz.plan.fly.help: Kotahi te kaupapa i te wā kotahi, kāore he tirotiro whakamahinga.
wz.plan.careful.help: E rua ngā kaupapa i te wā kotahi, ka mutu i te 60% o tō ohaurunga AI.
wz.plan.normal.help: E toru ngā kaupapa i te wā kotahi, ka mutu i te 90% o tō ohaurunga AI.

scale.h: Me pēhea te mahi a ngā kaiwhakahaere ki a koe
scale.sub: Ko te teitei ake ko te nui ake o te mea e kī ana te kopikopiko. Ka pānui ia rōpū i ngā hīkoi e nekehia ana e koe i tāna whakamārama.

scale.go.2: Tāpaetia he mahere, tatari ki taku haere
scale.go.3: Ngā mea iti (i raro i te haora) me te kore e pātai, ka tuhia hei whakatau
scale.go.4: Ngā kāri katoa me te kore e pātai; pātai anake mō ngā āhuatanga hou, te whānuitanga rānei
scale.go.5: Hangaia ngā mea katoa, kōrero mai ā muri
scale.go.help: Kotahi te rārangi e pānuitia ana e ia rōpū i tāna whakamārama.
scale.words.1: Kāore he kupu kaiwhakawhanake; whakamāramatia ngā mea katoa me te mea he hou ahau
scale.words.2: Kupu māmā; ka whai tētahi kupu kaiwhakawhanake i tētahi "(ko te tikanga...)" poto
scale.words.4: He pai ngā kupu kaiwhakawhanake, kia poto
scale.words.5: Te hōhonu hangarau katoa, ngā ingoa kōpaki me ngā tau rārangi

scale.tidy.3: He taitara poto me ngā kaupapa tohu

scale.thrift.custom: He kōtuitui o ōu ake (tautuhia i raro i Atu)
scale.thrift.help: Mā te hīkoi kotahi e tautuhi ngā tirotiro whakamahinga, ngā ōrau tahua e rua, te tepe rere me ngā kaiāwhina mō ia tauira (i raro i Atu). 1 he whakapau noa, 5 te iti rawa o te utu.
scale.push: 🧭 Te akiaki a te Scrum Master
scale.push.help: 1: ka tirotiro ia 30 meneti, ka pokepoke i ngā kāri kua pupuri neke atu i te rā kotahi. 3 (Pūmau): ia 10 meneti, kua pupuri neke atu i te 3 h, kotahi te whakamahara ngāwari mō tētahi pātai e tatari ana 4 h. 5: ia 2 meneti, kua pupuri neke atu i te 30 meneti, whakamahara i muri i te 1 h. Kāore he utu o ngā rauna; ka piki te tepe rere AI ia rā i te taumata (4, 6, 8, 12, 16).
scale.more: Atu: ngā tirotiro whakamahinga, te tahua, ngā rere me ngā kaiāwhina

help.start.p: Ko te AI-gile he papa mō ō kaupapa. He rōpū āwhina AI iti kei ia kaupapa: ka hoatu e koe ngā kāri, ka mahi rātou, ka tirohia e koe.

help.start.2: Tāpiri kāri: whakatuwherahia te kaupapa ka tāpiri he kāri e kī ana me aha te mahi. Ka tango te rōpū.
help.start.3: Ko Mōu tō rārangi ake: ngā mea e tatari ana mō tō whakautu, mō tō whakaaetanga rānei. Titiro ki reira i ētahi wā.
help.start.4: Ko ngā Karere (te pātene 💬 i te taha runga o te rēera mauī) ka taea e koe te kōrero ki tētahi rōpū tōtika, te pātai rānei ki tō kaiāwhina whaiaro.
help.start.more: E hiahia ana ki tētahi haerenga ārahi? Whakamahia te Haerenga i tēnei rārangi kōwhiri, whakamātau rānei i te Aratohu Whakaatu me ngā kaupapa wairangi.

gloss.title: 📖 Ngā kupu kua whakamāramatia
gloss.about: Te whakangungu koreutu i te reo māmā: ngā kupu katoa ka tūtaki ai koe, mai i te whakaaro tuatahi tae noa ki te ratonga e whirinaki ai te tangata, me Agile, te hanga, te pupuri haumaru me te mahi tahi me te AI i te haerenga.
gloss.about.noai: Te whakangungu koreutu i te reo māmā: ngā kupu katoa ka tūtaki ai koe, mai i te whakaaro tuatahi tae noa ki te ratonga e whirinaki ai te tangata, me Agile, te hanga me te pupuri haumaru i te haerenga.
gloss.g.team: 🤝 Te mahi hei rōpū (me te AI)
gloss.g.sec: 🔒 Te haumaru me te noho muna
gloss.g.ai: 🤖 Te mahi tahi me te AI
gloss.card.text: Kotahi te wāhanga mahi: he mahi, he bug, he whakaaro rānei. Ka nekehia i tētahi pou ki tētahi, kia oti rā anō.
gloss.project.text: He papa mō tētahi mea e hiahia ana koe kia oti, pēnei i tētahi taupānga, i tētahi whare taputapu māra, i tētahi haerenga rānei. Kei roto ngā kāri.
gloss.forteam.text: Te pou mō ngā kāri kua hoki anō ki te rōpū, hei tauira i muri i tō whakautu ki tā rātou pātai, i tō tono rānei kia whakarerekētia tētahi mea.
gloss.lead.text: Te kaiāwhina AI e whakahaere ana i tētahi kaupapa. Ka tango i ō kāri, ka tuari i te mahi, ka pātai ki a koe ina hiahia ia ki a koe.
gloss.agentprog.text: Te hōtaka AI kei tō rorohiko, pēnei i a Claude Code, ka whakaohoa e te papa ina he mahi mā ō kaiāwhina.
gloss.dispatcher.text: Te wāhanga o te papa ka pānui i tētahi kāri, i tētahi kōrero hou rānei, ka whakatau ko wai hei tango. Ka whakamahia ngā ture māmā i te tuatahi, he AI iti anake ina kore e tino mōhio.
gloss.space.text: He rōpū kaupapa e hono ana, pēnei i te kōpaki mō ngā papa. Ko te 🪐 te tohu mō tētahi.
gloss.playground.text: He kaupapa kua whakaritea mō tētahi hoa hei whakamātau i a AI-gile, me tētahi waehere pōwhiri hei tuku ki a ia.
gloss.hyperfocus.text: 🎯 Ka whakaatu i tētahi kaupapa kotahi me ō karere anake, kia kore ai he mea kē e kukume i a koe. Ka haere tonu ngā rōpū i ā rātou mahi.
gloss.qa.text: Te kupu poto mō quality assurance: ngā mea katoa e mahia ana kia tika te mahi i mua i te whakaputa. I AI-gile ko te tikanga ko ngā tirotiro aunoa: ina whero te QA, kua rahua tētahi mea, ā, kāore e taea te whakaputa kia whakatikatia rā anō.
gloss.release.text: He paihere mahi kua oti, he ingoa tōna, ka haere ora tahi, me ngā kōrero poto mō ngā mea i panoni. Ka tuhia e 🚀 Tukunga ngā kōrero mai i ngā kāri kua oti.
gloss.rollback.text: Te hoki ki te putanga whakamutunga i mahi ina raru i te putanga hou. I AI-gile, ka kohikohi te Huri whakamuri i ngā takahanga whakakore kua tuhia ki ia rerekētanga hei rārangi tirotiro kotahi.
gloss.live.text: Te putanga tūturu e whakamahia ana e te tangata, ehara i te kape hei whakamātau. E kīia ana hoki e ngā kaiwhakawhanake ko te production.
gloss.change.text: He panonitanga kua whakamaheretia ki tētahi mea e whakawhirinaki ana te tangata, kua tuhia i mua: he aha, he aha ai, te tūraru, āhea, me pēhea te huri whakamuri. Tīmatahia mā 🔀 Whakaara panonitanga.
gloss.risk.text: He mea ka hē pea, kua tohua he kaute mō te tūponotanga me te kino ka puta. Ka puritia e ⚠️ Ngā tūraru ki te rārangi kotahi, ko te kaute teitei rawa i mua, he rā tō ia mea kia tirohia anō.
gloss.chgwin.text: Ngā wā e āhei ai ngā panonitanga te haere ora, pēnei i tētahi ahiahi Tūrei mārie. I waho i te matapihi, kāore e taea te whakaoti i tētahi kāri panonitanga, ki te kore he ohotata.
gloss.gonogo.text: He tirotiro whakamutunga i mua tonu i te whakaputanga o tētahi rerekētanga: ka kī ia tangata me whakaae, “Haere”, “Kaua e haere” rānei. Ka haere anake ina kī te katoa “Haere”.
gloss.approval.text: Te tatari ki tētahi āe i mua i te tīmatanga o te mahi. Ka tatari tētahi kāri nā tētahi hoa i whakaara, he panonitanga rānei, i ✅ Ngā whakaaetanga kia whakaae, kia whakakāhore rānei koe.
gloss.quiettime.text: He wā, pēnei i te wā o tētahi pāho ora, o tētahi whakaaturanga, o te pō rānei, kāore he mea e whakaputaina. Ka haere tonu ngā rōpū i te mahi me te whakamātau, engari ka tatari te whakaputa kia mutu rā anō. I ētahi atu wāhi e kīia ana he change freeze.
gloss.service.text: He mea nāu i hanga e whakawhirinaki ana te tangata, pēnei i te paetukutuku, i te taupānga rānei, e tiakina ana kia mahi tonu. Tīkina “He ratonga tēnei kaupapa”, ka kī ai he aha tāna e tuku ana, ko wai e whakamahi ana, ko wai kei te on-call.
gloss.uptime.also: uptime checks,tirotiro wā e rere ana
gloss.uptime.text: He arowhai aunoa, ia meneti torutoru, kei te whakautu tonu tō ratonga. Ki te hapa i ētahi wā e hia nei i te rārangi, ka whakatuwhera a AI-gile i tētahi kāri aitua mā ōna anō.
gloss.statuspage.text: He whārangi tūmatanui e whakaatu ana mēnā kei te mahi tētahi ratonga (kākāriki, karaka, whero rānei) me te pānui hou rawa, kia taea e te hunga whakamahi te tirotiro, kaua e pātai.
gloss.incident.text: Tētahi mea kua pakaru, kāore rānei e mahi pai ana mō te hunga e whakamahi ana i tēnei wā, pēnei i te pae tukutuku kua hinga, tino pōturi rānei. Ka peke te kāri aituā 🔥 i te rārangi: ko te whakahoki kia mahi anō te mea tuatahi.
gloss.major.text: He aitua nui: he tokomaha kua pāngia, he moni, he raraunga rānei kei te mōrearea. Ka whakanohoia e te pātene kotahi ngā rōpū katoa ki runga (kāhui), ka whakaohongia te tangata kei te on-call, ka tonoa he whakahou tūnga ia 30 meneti.
gloss.oncall.text: Ko koe te tangata ka whakautu ina pakaru tētahi mea, ahakoa i te pō. He mema rōpū on-call tō ia ratonga, ko ia te tuatahi ka whakaohongia mō ōna aitua.
gloss.replyby.text: Te roa ka taea e tētahi kāri te tatari mō te whakautu tuatahi, hei tauira kotahi hāora mō tētahi aitua. I muri i tērā ka whiwhi karaka whero, kia kaua tētahi mea e wareware puku. Ka kīia hoki he whāinga whakautu.
gloss.postmortem.word: Arotake i muri i te aitua
gloss.postmortem.text: He titiro poto whakamuri i muri i tētahi aitua: te mea i pā, te mea i āwhina me te mea me panoni, me te kore whakahē i tētahi. Kāore e taea te kati i tētahi aitua mēnā kāore he arotake.
gloss.problem.text: Te take huna kei muri i tētahi aitua, i ētahi aitua rānei. Ka whakarōpū tētahi kāri 🧩 raruraru i ngā aitua e hoki mai tonu ana, kia kitea ai te take, kia whakatikahia mō ake tonu.
gloss.rootcause.text: Te take tūturu i pakaru ai tētahi mea, ehara i te mea i kitea e koe e hē ana anake. Whakatikahia te pūtake tūturu, ā, ka mutu te hoki mai o te aitua.
gloss.workaround.text: He huarahi e mahi tonu ai ngā mea kia rite rā anō te whakatika tūturu, pēnei i te tīmata anō i tētahi mea ina mau. Ka tuhia ki te kāri raruraru kia kaua tētahi e whakaaro anō.
gloss.knownerror.also: ngā hapa e mōhiotia ana,known error
gloss.knownerror.text: He raru kua mārama te take engari kāore anō kia whakatikatia, i te nuinga o te wā me tētahi huarahi huri kua tuhia. Kei te 🧩 Hapa e mōhiotia ana te rārangi o ēnei, kia whakamahi ai te katoa i te huarahi huri, kaua e keri anō.
gloss.runbook.text: He tohutohu hipanga i te hipanga hei whakatika i tētahi momo raru e mōhiotia ana, kia ōrite te mahi, kia tere, i ia wā. I muri i tētahi aitua nui ka taea e te rōpū te tūtohu i tētahi mā tō OK.
gloss.backup.text: He kape kua tiakina o ō raraunga mai i mua, hei whakawhirinaki mēnā ka ngaro, ka pakaru rānei tētahi mea. Ka hanga a AI-gile i tētahi kape tiaki o ō papa ia rā.
gloss.restore.text: Te whakahoki mai i ngā raraunga i tētahi kape tiaki. Ka whai tikanga tūturu te kape tiaki ina mōhio koe ka taea te whakahoki mai, nō reira he pai te whakamātau i ētahi wā.
gloss.dod.also: Definition of Ready,DoD,DoR,whakamārama o te oti
gloss.dod.text: Te rārangi-tirotiro poto a te rōpū mō te tikanga o “oti”, pēnei i te whakamātautia me te whakamāramatia, i mua i te tukunga o tētahi kāri ki a koe. Ko tōna māhanga, te Whakamārama o Rite, e kī ana āhea e mārama ai te kāri kia tīmata.
gloss.testpile.text: Ngā kāri kua oti e tatari ana kia whakamātauria e koe, tētahi i muri i tētahi. Whakaaetia tētahi, whakahokia rānei me tētahi tuhipoka, ā, ka puta mai te mea e whai ake ana.
gloss.retro.text: He tiro whakamuri auau ki te āhua o te mahi a te rōpū, kia whakaae ai ki tētahi mea, e rua rānei hei whakapai ake ā muri ake. Te kupu poto mō retrospective. I AI-gile ka whakatakoto te retro i tētahi rerekētanga ki ngā tikanga mahi a te rōpū, ā, ka kī koe “Haere”, “Kāore anō” rānei.
gloss.peerreview.text: He kanohi tuarua: ka tirotiro tētahi atu, ehara i te kaituhi, i te mahi i mua i tōna tae ki a koe, kia iti ake ai ngā hapa ka pahemo. I AI-gile ka tirotiro tētahi atu AI i ia kāri.
gloss.swarm.text: Mahi tahi katoa: he maha ngā tāngata ka whakarere i ētahi atu mahi hei whakatika tahi i tētahi take ohorere kia oti rā anō. I AI-gile ka āwhina ia rōpū i tētahi kaupapa kotahi, ā, ka tatari ētahi atu kaupapa i tērā wā.
gloss.scrummaster.text: I Scrum, ko te tangata e āwhina ana i te rōpū kia mahi pai: ka whakakore i ngā aukati, ka pupuri i ngā hui ki te ara, ka whakaako i ngā tikanga pai, me te kore e whakahau taikaha i tētahi. I AI-gile ka kite te Lead Scrum Master i ngā kāri kua mau, ka akiaki i ngā rōpū, ka whakamahara hoki i a koe ki ngā mea e tatari ana, puta noa i ia kaupapa.
gloss.scrummaster.text.noai: I Scrum, ko te tangata e āwhina ana i te rōpū kia mahi pai: ka whakakore i ngā aukati, ka pupuri i ngā hui ki te ara, ka whakaako i ngā tikanga pai, me te kore e whakahau taikaha i tētahi. Ki te kore he AI, ka kite te putanga a AI-gile i ngā kāri kua mau, ā, ka mahi mā ngā whakahau pūmau, pēnei i te whakaraupapa i Hei mahi.
gloss.discovery.text: Te wāhanga tuatahi o te rapu he aha te raru e whai take ana kia whakaotia, mō wai hoki, i mua i te hanga i tētahi mea.
gloss.problemstmt.text: Kotahi, e rua rānei ngā rerenga kōrero e kī ana ko wai kei a ia te raru, he aha taua raru, he aha hoki te take nui, kia kotahi ai te whāinga a te katoa.
gloss.user.text: Te tangata e whakamahi ana i tā koe e hanga ana. Ko ōna hiahia te take o te mahi.
gloss.stakeholder.text: Ia tangata e aro ana ki te putanga o te mahi, e pāngia ana rānei e taua mahi, pēnei i te hunga e utu ana, e whakamahi ana, e tautoko ana rānei.
gloss.persona.text: He tangata pohewa, engari he āhua tūturu, hei māngai mō tētahi momo kaiwhakamahi, kia pātai ai te rōpū, “Ka māmā tēnei ki a Hēmi?”
gloss.userresearch.also: rangahau kaiwhakamahi, user interviews, uiui kaiwhakamahi
gloss.userresearch.text: Te kōrero ki ngā tāngata tūturu me te mātakitaki i a rātou, kia mōhio ai he aha ā rātou hiahia, kaua e whakapae noa.
gloss.journey.text: Ngā takahanga e whakatutuki ai te tangata i tētahi mahi, mai i tana rongo tuatahi tae noa ki te otinga, tae atu ki waho i tāu hua. Mā te tuhi i tēnei ka kitea ngā wāhi e raru ai rātou.
gloss.painpoint.text: Tētahi mea e whakahōhā ana, e whakapōturi ana rānei i te tangata i tēnei wā. Ka whakakorea e ngā hua pai ngā wāhi mamae.
gloss.assumption.text: Tētahi mea e whakapono ana koe engari kāore anō kia tirohia. Mā te tuhi i ngā whakapae ka kitea he aha hei whakamātau i te tuatahi.
gloss.hypothesis.text: He matapae pai rawa e whakamahere ana koe ki te tirotiro, me te mea e tūmanako ana koe ka puta, pēnei i “ka haina mai te tangata mēnā he utu kore te marama tuatahi”.
gloss.experiment.text: He whakamātau iti kua whakaritea hei mōhio mēnā e whai hua ana tētahi whakaaro, i mua i te whakapau nui ki runga.
gloss.poc.text: He whakamātau tere, taratara hei kite mēnā ka taea rawa tētahi whakaaro. I te nuinga o te wā ka makaia atu ina whiwhi koe i te whakautu.
gloss.prototype.text: He tauira moata o te hua, he pikitia ka taea te pātō i te nuinga o te wā, hei whakamātau i te whakaaro ki ngā tāngata i mua i te hanga tika.
gloss.wireframe.text: He huahua māmā o tētahi mata e whakaatu ana i te wāhi mō ia mea, kāore he tae, kāore he ihirangi tūturu.
gloss.mockup.text: He pikitia taipitopito e whakaatu ana i te āhua o tētahi mata, me ōna tae me ōna kupu tūturu, engari kāore anō tētahi mea kia mahi.
gloss.bizcase.text: Ngā take hei whakatutuki i tētahi kaupapa: te utu, ngā hua ka puta mai, ngā moni ka penapenatia rānei, me ngā tūraru.
gloss.feasibility.text: Mēnā ka taea tūturu te hanga me te tiaki i tētahi mea i runga i te wā, te moni me ngā pūkenga kei a koe.
gloss.outcome.text: Te rerekētanga e hiahia ana koe mō ngā tāngata, pēnei i te iti ake o ngā hui kua hapa. He nui ake tōna hira i te nui o tā koe i hanga ai.
gloss.output.text: Tētahi mea ka hangaia e te rōpū, pēnei i tētahi mata hou, i tētahi pūrongo rānei. Ahakoa kua hangaia, ehara i te mea kua āwhina i tētahi.
gloss.successmetric.text: He tau e whakaatu ana mēnā i whakatutuki te mahi i tōna take, pēnei i te nui ake o te hunga e whakaoti ana i tā rātou ota.
gloss.kpi.text: He tau hira e mātakitaki ana koe hei kite mēnā e pai ana te haere, pēnei i te maha o ngā hainga ia wiki.
gloss.okr.word: Ngā whāinga me ngā hua matua (OKR)
gloss.okr.text: He tikanga whakarite whāinga: ka kī te whāinga he aha tāu e hiahia ana, ā, ko ētahi hua matua he tau hei whakaatu kua tae koe.
gloss.product.text: Te mea e hangaia ana, e tiakina ana mō ōna kaiwhakamahi, pēnei i tētahi taupānga, i tētahi pae tukutuku, i tētahi taputapu rānei.
gloss.vision.word: Tirohanga whakamua o te hua (Product vision)
gloss.vision.also: tirohanga whakamua o te hua, vision statement
gloss.vision.text: He tauākī poto mō ko wai e āwhinatia ana e te hua me tōna ahunga whakamua mō te wā roa.
gloss.po.text: Te tangata ka whakatau he aha te mea ka hangaia, ā, i tēhea raupapa, kia mahi tonu te rōpū i te mea nui rawa. I roto i a AI-gile, ko koe tērā.
gloss.pm.text: Te tangata e tiaki ana i te ahunga o tētahi hua: ko ēhea raru e whakatauria ana, mō wai, he aha hoki. Ka tikanga hoki te PM ko te kaiwhakahaere kaupapa, nō reira tirohia.
gloss.projmgr.text: Te tangata e pupuri ana i te kaupapa kia tika te wā me te tahua, e aroturuki ana ko wai e mahi ana i te aha, ā, hei āhea.
gloss.roadmap.text: He mahere whānui mō ngā mea e haere mai ana i ngā marama e heke mai nei, i runga i te raupapa. E whakaatu ana i te ahunga, ehara i ngā rā tōtika, ā, ka rerekē i a koe e ako ana.
gloss.milestone.text: He wāhi i roto i te kaupapa e tika ana kia tohua, pēnei i “kua whakaputaina te putanga tuatahi”, i “kotahi rau ngā kaiwhakamahi” rānei.
gloss.mvp.word: Hua iti rawa e whai hua ana (Minimum viable product, MVP)
gloss.mvp.text: Te putanga iti rawa o tētahi hua e whai hua tonu ana mō ngā tāngata tūturu, kia ako ai koe i a rātou i te wā moata.
gloss.requirement.text: Tētahi mea me mahi, me whai rānei te hua kua oti.
gloss.scope.text: Ngā mea kei roto i te mahi, ā, he ōrite te hira, ngā mea kāore i roto.
gloss.scopecreep.word: Te tupu haere o te whānuitanga (Scope creep)
gloss.scopecreep.also: te tupu haere o te whānuitanga, feature creep
gloss.scopecreep.text: Ina tāpiritia haeretia ētahi mea anō ki te mahi, paku noa iho ia wā, kāore he tangata i whakaae ki te wā, ki te utu tāpiri rānei, nō reira kāore e tino oti.
gloss.feature.text: Tētahi mea ka taea e te hua te mahi mō ngā tāngata, pēnei i “tautuhi anō i tō kupuhipa”.
gloss.epic.text: He mahi nui, rahi rawa kia oti i te kotahi haere, nō reira ka wehea ki ngā kāri iti ake.
gloss.story.text: He wāhanga mahi iti i tuhia mai i te taha o te kaiwhakamahi: “Hei kaihoko, e hiahia ana ahau ki te penapena i taku kete, kia whakaoti ai ahau ā muri ake.” Ko te tīmatanga tēnei o te kōrero mō te mea hei hanga.
gloss.ac.text: Ngā tirotiro me tutuki i tētahi kāri kia kīia kua oti, i whakaaetia i mua i te tīmatanga o te mahi, pēnei i “kei reira tonu te kete i muri i te takiuru ki waho, ki roto anō”.
gloss.task.text: Kotahi te mahi hei whakaoti, he takahanga iti o tētahi kōrero kaiwhakamahi nui ake i te nuinga o te wā.
gloss.ticket.text: Tētahi atu kupu mō te kāri: kotahi te wāhanga mahi, kotahi te tono rānei, e aroturukitia ana mai i te tīmatanga ki te mutunga.
gloss.priority.text: Te hira, te hohoro rānei o tētahi mea ina whakatauritea ki ērā atu, kia mahia tuatahitia ai te mahi nui rawa.
gloss.prioritise.text: Te whakarite i te mahi i runga i te raupapa hira. Ko tētahi tikanga rongonui ko MoSCoW: Me whai (Must), Me whai pea (Should), Ka taea te whai (Could), Kāore i tēnei wā (Won’t).
gloss.estimate.text: He matapae pai rawa mō te rahi, te roa rānei o tētahi mahi. He matapae, ehara i te kupu oati.
gloss.storypoints.text: He tikanga whakatau i te rahi o te mahi mā te whakataurite i ngā kāri ki a rātou anō (“tata ki te rua whakarea te rahi i tērā”), kaua mā ngā hāora. Ehara ēnei i te mea hei whakataurite i ngā rōpū.
gloss.tshirt.text: Te whakatau i te rahi o te mahi hei S, M, L, XL rānei. He tere, ā, he rawaka mō te whakamahere moata.
gloss.poker.text: He kēmu mō te whakatau tata: ka whakaatu te katoa i tētahi kāri rahi i te wā kotahi, kātahi ka whakamārama te hunga i tohu i te rahi nui rawa me te iti rawa i te take.
gloss.dependency.text: Ina kore e taea tētahi mahi te tīmata, te whakaoti rānei, kia tīmata, kia oti rānei rā anō tētahi atu.
gloss.blocker.text: Tētahi mea e aukati ana i te mahi i te neke whakamua i tēnei wā, pēnei i tētahi whakautu kāore anō kia tae, i tētahi taputapu pakaru rānei.
gloss.deadline.text: Te rā me oti tētahi mea.
gloss.deliverable.text: Tētahi mea tūturu ka puta mai i te mahi ka tukuna atu, pēnei i tētahi whārangi e mahi ana, i tētahi pūrongo rānei.
gloss.forecast.text: He matapae mō te mea ka puta pea, pēnei i te wā ka oti te mahi, i runga i tāu e mōhio ana tae noa ki nāianei.
gloss.metric.text: Tētahi mea e inea ana, e aroturukitia ana i te roanga o te wā, pēnei i te maha o ngā toro ki tētahi whārangi, i te roa rānei o te whakatika.
gloss.feedback.text: Ngā kōrero a te tangata ki a koe mō tāu mahi, te pai me te kino. Ko te whiwhi i ēnei i te wā moata, i ngā wā maha hoki, te iho o Agile.
gloss.agile.also: Agile development,agile ways of working,whakawhanake Agile
gloss.agile.text: He tikanga mahi i ngā takahanga iti: hanga paku, whakaatu hua pono i ngā wā maha, ako i ngā kōrero a te tangata, whakarerekē hoki i te mahere i a koe e haere ana, kaua e whakamahere i ngā mea katoa i te tīmatanga.
gloss.manifesto.also: Manifesto for Agile Software Development,tauākī Agile
gloss.manifesto.text: He tauākī poto i tuhia i te tau 2001 e ngā kaihanga pūmanawa. Ka whakanuia ake e ia ngā tāngata, ngā hua e mahi ana, te mahi tata ki ngā kiritaki me te urupare ki te panonitanga, i ngā mahere taumaha me ngā pepa maha.
gloss.waterfall.text: Te tikanga mahi tawhito: whakamahere i ngā mea katoa, kātahi ka hanga katoa, kātahi ka whakamātau katoa, tētahi wāhanga i muri i tētahi. He uaua, he utu nui hoki ngā rerekētanga i te wā tōmuri.
gloss.iteration.text: Kotahi te hurihanga o te hanga i tētahi mea, te tirotiro, me te whakapai ake. He raupapa o ēnei te mahi Agile, ā, he momo hurihanga te sprint.
gloss.increment.text: He wāhanga hou e mahi ana ka tāpiritia ki te hua i roto i tētahi sprint, i tētahi hurihanga mahi rānei, ā, e hāngai ana ki ngā mea kei reira kē.
gloss.scrum.text: He tikanga mahi Agile rongonui: ka mahi tētahi rōpū iti i roto i ngā sprint poto ki tētahi whāinga, me ngā tūranga kua whakaritea me ētahi hui auau mō te whakamahere, te tirotiro me te whakapai ake.
gloss.scrumteam.text: Te rōpū iti e mahi ana i Scrum: he kaipupuri hua, he Scrum Master me ngā kaiwhakawhanake.
gloss.ceremonies.text: Ngā hui auau i Scrum: te whakamahere sprint, te Scrum ia rā, te arotake sprint me te retro. He tokomaha e kī ana he huihuinga (ceremonies) ēnei.
gloss.sprintplan.text: Te hui i te tīmatanga o tētahi sprint e whakaae ai te rōpū he aha te hira o te sprint, ko ēhea kāri hei tango, me pēhea te tīmata.
gloss.sprintgoal.text: Kotahi te rerenga kōrero e kī ana he aha te take o te sprint. Ka taea te whakarerekē i ngā mahi iti i te haerenga, kia tutuki tonu te whāinga.
gloss.sprintbacklog.text: Ngā kāri kua tīpakohia mō te sprint o nāianei, me te mahere a te rōpū hei mahi i ērā.
gloss.productbacklog.text: Te rārangi katoa kua whakaraupapatia o ngā mea ka hangaia pea mō te hua, kei runga te mea nui rawa. Ka rerekē tonu i a koe e ako ana.
gloss.productgoal.text: Te putanga nui ake e whāia ana e te hua, hei āwhina i te rōpū ki te kōwhiri i te mahi ka whai ake.
gloss.refinement.word: Te whakapai i te rārangi mahi (Backlog refinement)
gloss.refinement.also: te whakapai i te rārangi mahi, backlog grooming,refinement
gloss.refinement.text: Te haere auau i te rārangi mahi hei whakanahanaha, wāwāhi, whakaraupapa me te tāpiri taipitopito ki ngā kāri, kia rite ai hei tango. E kīia ana hoki he backlog grooming.
gloss.sprintreview.text: He hui i te mutunga o te sprint e whakaatu ai te rōpū i āna mahi kua oti, ā, e whakarongo ai ki ngā whakaaro o te tangata, hei whakatau i te mea ka whai ake.
gloss.demo.text: Te whakaatu i te mahi kua oti e mahi ana, ā-ora, ki te hunga i tono.
gloss.timebox.text: He wā kua whakaritea mō tētahi mea. Ka pau te wā, ka mutu koe, ahakoa kāore anō kia oti katoa.
gloss.velocity.also: tere o te rōpū, team velocity
gloss.velocity.text: Te nui o te mahi e oti ana i te rōpū i ia sprint, e whakamahia ana hei whakamahere i te nui hei tango ā muri ake. Ehara i te kaute mō te pukumahi o te tangata.
gloss.capacity.text: Te nui o te mahi ka taea e te rōpū te tango i tētahi wā, i muri i ngā hararei me ētahi atu mahi.
gloss.burndown.text: He kauwhata o te mahi e toe ana i te sprint e heke ana ia rā. Mēnā e papatahi tonu ana te rārangi, kua mau tētahi mea.
gloss.burnup.text: He kauwhata o te mahi kua oti e piki ana i te roanga o te wā, i te taha o te tapeke i whakamaheretia, kia kitea ai āhea koe tae ai ki reira.
gloss.kanbanboard.text: Ko te papa ake: he pou mō ia takahanga o te mahi, ā, ka neke whakawhiti ngā kāri.
gloss.pullsys.text: He tikanga mahi e tīmata ai te mahi hou ina he wāhi ki tētahi hei tango, kaua e pēhia ki runga ki tētahi kua kī kē.
gloss.flow.also: te rere o te mahi, flow of work
gloss.flow.text: Te maeneene o te neke o te mahi i te papa. Ko te tikanga o te rere pai, ka neke tonu ngā kāri, kaua e kōpuni.
gloss.leadtime.text: Te roa mai i te tono a tētahi tae noa ki te otinga.
gloss.cycletime.text: Te roa o tētahi kāri mai i te tīmatanga pono o te mahi ki taua kāri tae noa ki te otinga.
gloss.throughput.text: Te maha o ngā kāri e oti ana i te wiki, i tētahi wā kua whakaritea rānei.
gloss.bottleneck.text: Te takahanga kotahi e kōpuni ai te mahi, ā, ka whakaroa i ngā mea katoa i muri, pēnei i te kakī whāiti o te pounamu.
gloss.swimlane.text: He rārangi whakawhiti i te papa e kohikohi ana i ngā kāri o te momo kotahi, pēnei i te mahi ohorere, i ngā kāri a tētahi rōpū rānei.
gloss.lean.text: He tikanga mahi e tapahi ana i te moumou (ngā mea katoa kāore e āwhina i te kiritaki), ā, e pupuri ana i te rere o te mahi.
gloss.waste.text: I Lean, ko ngā mea katoa e pau ai te kaha engari kāore e āwhina i te kiritaki, pēnei i te tatari, te mahi anō, te hanga rānei i ngā mea kāore he tangata e whakamahi.
gloss.kaizen.text: Te whakapai paku haere i ngā wā katoa mā ngā rerekētanga iti auau, kātahi ka tirotiro mēnā i whai hua. Ko te retro tētahi huarahi. E kīia ana hoki he kaizen.
gloss.selforg.word: Rōpū whakahaere i a ia anō (Self-organising team)
gloss.selforg.also: rōpū whakahaere i a ia anō, self-organising,self-managing team
gloss.selforg.text: He rōpū ka whakatau mā tōna anō me pēhea te mahi, kaua e kīia atu ia takahanga.
gloss.crossfunc.text: He rōpū kei a ia ngā pūkenga katoa e hiahiatia ana hei whakaoti i te mahi mā tōna anō, pēnei i te hoahoa, te hanga me te whakamātau.
gloss.spike.text: He rangahau poto, he pouaka wā tōna, hei whakautu i tētahi pātai i mua i te whakaū ki te mahi tūturu.
gloss.rework.text: Te mahi anō i te mahi nā te mea kāore i tika i te tuatahi.
gloss.safe.text: Ngā tikanga hei whakamahi i a Agile puta noa i ngā rōpū maha i tētahi whakahaere nui. Ko SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) tētahi tauira rongonui.
gloss.code.text: Ngā tohutohu kua tuhia e kī ana ki te rorohiko he aha tāna mahi. E kīia ana hoki he source code.
gloss.proglang.text: He reo mō te tuhi waehere, pēnei i a JavaScript, Python, Java rānei. He pai ake ētahi mō ētahi momo mahi.
gloss.developer.text: Te tangata e tuhi ana, e whakarerekē ana hoki i te waehere. E kīia ana hoki he programmer, he software engineer rānei.
gloss.software.text: Ngā hōtaka e rere ana i runga i ngā rorohiko me ngā waea, kaua ko ngā pūrere tonu (te pūmārō, hardware).
gloss.app.text: He kupu poto mō application: he hōtaka e whakamahia ana e te tangata hei whakaoti i tētahi mahi, i runga i te waea, i te rorohiko, i te pūtirotiro tukutuku rānei.
gloss.webapp.text: He taupānga e rere ana i roto i te pūtirotiro tukutuku, nō reira kāore he mea hei tāuta.
gloss.frontend.text: Te wāhanga o te taupānga e kitea ana, e pātōhia ana e koe: ngā mata, ngā pātene me ngā kupu, i te nuinga o te wā kei tō pūtirotiro.
gloss.backend.text: Te wāhanga kei muri i te atamira o te taupānga e pupuri ana i ngā raraunga, e mahi ana hoki ina pātō koe i tētahi mea, pēnei i te tirotiro i tō kupuhipa.
gloss.fullstack.word: Full stack (taha mua me taha muri)
gloss.fullstack.also: full-stack, taha mua me taha muri
gloss.fullstack.text: Te mahi i te taha mua me te taha muri e rua.
gloss.ui.text: Te mea e kitea ana, e whakamahia ana e te tangata i te mata: te whakatakotoranga, ngā pātene, ngā tahua me ngā kupu.
gloss.ux.text: Te āhua o te whakamahi i tētahi mea: he māmā, he mārama, he āhuareka; he pōrearea, he pōturi rānei.
gloss.accessibility.text: Te whakarite kia taea e te katoa te whakamahi i ngā mea, tae atu ki te hunga kāore e tino kite, kāore e taea e rātou te whakamahi i te kiore, e whakamahi ana rānei i te kaipānui mata.
gloss.responsive.text: Te whakarite kia hāngai, kia pai hoki te mahi o ngā whārangi i runga i ngā rahi mata katoa, mai i te waea ki te mata nui.
gloss.designsys.text: He pūkete tiritahi o ngā tae, ngā momotuhi, ngā pātene me ngā ture, kia rite ai te āhua me te mahi o ia mata.
gloss.architecture.text: Te āhua whānui o tētahi pūnaha: ko ēhea ngā wāhanga matua, me pēhea tā rātou kōrero ki a rātou anō.
gloss.database.text: He pātaka kua whakaritea mō ngā mōhiohio, pēnei i tētahi ripanga tino kaha ka taea e te taupānga te pānui, te whakarerekē hoki.
gloss.schema.text: Te whakatakotoranga o tētahi pātengi raraunga: he aha ngā ripanga mōhiohio kei roto, he aha hoki ngā mea ka haere ki ia ripanga.
gloss.sql.text: He kupu poto mō structured query language: te reo e whakamahia ana hei pātai mōhiohio i ngā pātengi raraunga maha, hei whakarerekē rānei i a rātou.
gloss.data.text: Ngā mōhiohio e pupuritia ana e te rorohiko, pēnei i ngā ingoa, ngā ota, ngā tautuhinga rānei.
gloss.server.text: He rorohiko e kā tonu ana, e whakautu ana ki ngā tono a ētahi atu rorohiko, pēnei i te tuku i tētahi whārangi tukutuku ina toro atu koe.
gloss.client.text: Te taha e tono ana i tētahi mea, te nuinga o te wā ko tō pūtirotiro, ko tō taupānga rānei, e kōrero ana ki tētahi tūmau. I te pakihi ka tikanga hoki ko te kiritaki.
gloss.api.text: He kupu poto mō application programming interface: he tahua tono ka taea e tētahi hōtaka te tuku ki tētahi atu, pēnei i te pātai ki tētahi ratonga huarere mō te matapae o te rā nei.
gloss.endpoint.text: Tētahi tūemi o te tahua a tētahi API: he wāhitau tukutuku ka taea e tētahi hōtaka te karanga hei tiki, hei tuku rānei i tētahi mea.
gloss.integration.text: Te hono i ngā pūnaha e rua kia mahi tahi, pēnei i tō toa e tuku ana i ngā ota ki tō pūmanawa kaute.
gloss.webhook.text: He karere ka tukuna e tētahi pūnaha ki tētahi atu mā tōna anō i te wā tonu ka puta tētahi mea, pēnei i “kua tae mai te utu”.
gloss.library.text: He waehere kua oti kē te tuhi e tētahi atu, ka taea e koe te whakamahi anō, kaua e tuhi mā koe anō.
gloss.framework.text: He hanganga kua oti kē mō te hanga taupānga e whakatau ana i te nuinga o te whakatakotoranga o te waehere, pēnei i te anga whare ka whakakīia e koe.
gloss.sdk.word: Kete whakawhanake pūmanawa (Software development kit, SDK)
gloss.sdk.text: He pouaka taputapu, waehere me ngā tauira mō te hanga pūmanawa mō tētahi pūhara, ratonga rānei.
gloss.softdep.text: He pātaka waehere, he taputapu rānei e hiahiatia ana e tō waehere kia mahi ai. He mea nui kia hou tonu ēnei mō te haumaru.
gloss.package.text: He paihere waehere kua oti kē, ka taea te tāuta me te whakamahi i roto i tētahi kaupapa.
gloss.pkgmgr.text: He taputapu e tiki ana, e whakahōu ana hoki i ngā pūkete e whirinaki ai tō waehere. Ko npm tētahi e whakamahia nuitia ana.
gloss.git.text: Te taputapu e whakamahia whānuitia ana hei pupuri i te hītori o ngā rerekētanga waehere, mā ngā commit me ngā branch.
gloss.github.text: He pae tukutuku e pupuri ana i ngā Git repo ki runga ipurangi, kia taea ai e ngā rōpū te tiritiri waehere, te arotake rerekētanga me te aroturuki mahi.
gloss.vcs.also: whakahaere putanga, source control,version control system
gloss.vcs.text: Te pupuri i te hītori katoa o ia rerekētanga ki ngā kōnae, kia kite ai koe ko wai nāna i whakarerekē he aha, ā, ka taea te hoki ki muri mēnā e tika ana. Ka mahi a Git i tēnei.
gloss.clone.text: Te hanga i tētahi tārua tino katoa o tētahi repo, me tōna hītori, ki tō rorohiko.
gloss.pull.text: Te tiki mai i ngā commit hou rawa mai i te tārua tiritahi (pēnei i GitHub) ki tō rorohiko. Te tauaro o push.
gloss.mainbranch.text: Te putanga ōkawa o te waehere e mahi ai te katoa, e kīia ana he main, he master rānei.
gloss.conflict.text: Ina pā ngā rerekētanga e rua ki ngā rārangi kotahi i ngā tikanga rerekē, nō reira kāore e taea e te rorohiko te whakakotahi, ā, me kōwhiri te tangata.
gloss.diff.text: He tirohanga e whakaatu tika ana he aha i rerekē i waenga i ngā putanga e rua: ngā rārangi kua tāpiria me ngā rārangi kua tangohia.
gloss.fork.text: Tō ake tārua o te repo a tētahi atu, ka taea e koe te whakarerekē me te kore e pā ki tāna.
gloss.script.text: He hōtaka poto e mahi ana i tētahi mahi mā tōna anō, pēnei i te whakapai i ngā kōnae, i te tīmata rānei i te taupānga.
gloss.build.text: Te huri i te waehere hei mea e rite ana ki te rere, te hua rānei kua rite ki te rere.
gloss.compile.text: Te whakamāori i te waehere i tuhia e te tangata hei āhua ka taea e te rorohiko te rere tika.
gloss.cli.text: He matapihi kuputuhi e patopato ai koe i ngā tohutohu mō te rorohiko, kaua e pātō. E kīia ana hoki he terminal.
gloss.config.text: Ngā tautuhinga e whakahaere ana i te āhua o te mahi a te pūmanawa, ka puritia wehe i te waehere kia ngāwari ai te whakarerekē.
gloss.envvar.text: He tautuhinga ka hoatu ki tētahi hōtaka ina tīmata, e whakamahia ana mō ngā wāhitau, mō ngā kupuhipa rānei, kia kore ai e tuhia ki te waehere.
gloss.debugging.text: Te rapu he aha i kore ai e mahi tētahi mea, me te whakatika.
gloss.pairing.text: Tokorua (he tangata me tētahi AI rānei) e mahi tahi ana i te waehere kotahi: ko tētahi e patopato ana, ko tētahi e tirotiro ana.
gloss.docs.text: Ngā whakamārama kua tuhia e pā ana ki te āhua o te mahi, te whakamahi rānei o tētahi mea.
gloss.readme.text: Te kōnae tuatahi hei pānui i roto i tētahi repo: he aha te kaupapa, ā, me pēhea te whakarite kia rere.
gloss.legacy.text: He pūnaha tawhito e whakamahia tonutia ana, he uaua ki te whakarerekē, i te nuinga o te wā nā te mea he ruarua noa e mārama tonu ana ki taua pūnaha.
gloss.techdebt.text: Ngā ara poto e penapena wā ana ināianei, engari ka pōturi ake ngā panonitanga ā muri ake, pēnei i tētahi nama ka tipu tōna huamoni. Mā te refactoring e utu whakaiti.
gloss.autotest.text: He tirotiro ka whakahaerehia e te rorohiko mā tōna anō i ia wā ka rerekē te waehere, hei hopu i ngā hapa i te wā moata.
gloss.manualtest.text: He tangata e whakamātau ā-ringa ana i te mahi kia kite mēnā e mahi ana i te āhua e tika ana.
gloss.unittest.text: He tirotiro aunoa iti mō tētahi wāhanga waehere iti kotahi, wehe i ērā atu.
gloss.integtest.text: He tirotiro mēnā e pai ana te mahi tahi a ētahi wāhanga maha, kaua ko te wāhanga kotahi anake i te wā kotahi.
gloss.endtoend.word: Whakamātau mai i te tīmatanga ki te mutunga (End-to-end test, E2E)
gloss.endtoend.text: He whakamātau e rite ana ki tētahi kaiwhakamahi tūturu mai i te tīmatanga ki te mutunga, pēnei i te haina mai, te hoko me te utu.
gloss.uat.word: Whakamātau whakaae kaiwhakamahi (User acceptance testing, UAT)
gloss.uat.text: Ka whakamātau te hunga i tono i te mahi mā rātou anō, ā, ka kī mēnā e rite ana ki ā rātou hiahia. Ko te Puranga whakamātautau a AI-gile tāna momo o tēnei.
gloss.regression.text: Tētahi mea i mahi i mua engari kua pakaru i muri i te rerekētanga. Ka tirotiro ngā regression test mēnā e mahi tonu ana ngā mea tawhito.
gloss.smoke.text: He tirotiro tino tere mēnā e mahi ana ngā mea matua, hei tauira i muri tonu i te whakaputanga o tētahi rerekētanga. Ki te rahua, kati, tirohia.
gloss.exploratory.text: Te whakamātau noa i te hua me te tūhura i a ia i ngā huarahi maha, hei rapu raru ka ngaro i ngā tirotiro kua whakaritea.
gloss.testcase.text: Kotahi te āhuatanga kua tuhia hei whakamātau: ngā takahanga me te mea e tika ana kia puta.
gloss.coverage.text: Te nui o te waehere e tirohia ana e ngā whakamātau aunoa. Ko te nui ake, ko te haumaru ake i te nuinga o te wā, engari kāore te whānuitanga teitei anake e whakaatu he pai te mahi.
gloss.testdata.text: Ngā mōhiohio tauira i hangaia noa hei whakamahi i te wā whakamātau, kia kore ai e puta ngā taipitopito muna o tētahi tangata pono.
gloss.edgecase.text: He āhuatanga rerekē i ngā tapa, pēnei i tētahi puka kau, i tētahi ingoa he tohu apostrophe tōna rānei, ā, ko ēnei ngā wāhi e pakaru ai ngā mea i te nuinga o te wā.
gloss.happypath.text: Te ara noa e tika ana ngā mea katoa. Ko te whakamātau pai ka whakamātau hoki i ngā ara kāore i te harikoa.
gloss.perftest.text: Te tirotiro i te tere o tētahi mea me tōna kaha ki te ū i raro i te pēhanga.
gloss.loadtest.text: Te tirotiro i te ū o tētahi pūnaha ina tokomaha ngā tāngata e whakamahi ana i te wā kotahi.
gloss.sectest.text: Te rapu i ngā ngoikoretanga e āhei ai pea tētahi ki te whakamahi hē i tētahi pūnaha, ki te kite rānei i ngā mea kāore e tika kia kitea e ia.
gloss.accesstest.text: Te tirotiro mēnā ka taea e ngā tāngata he rerekē ō rātou āheinga te whakamahi i te hua, tae atu ki te kaipānui mata, ki te papa pātuhi anake rānei.
gloss.linting.text: He tirotiro aunoa e kite ana i ngā hapa pea me te tuhi kāore i te nahanaha i roto i te waehere, pēnei i te kaitirotiro takikupu mō ngā hōtaka.
gloss.static.text: Te tirotiro i te waehere mō ngā raru mā te pānui aunoa, me te kore e whakarere.
gloss.flaky.text: He whakamātau ka tutuki i ētahi wā, ka rahua i ētahi wā, kāore he take mārama, nō reira kāore e taea te tino whakawhirinaki.
gloss.repro.also: repro,reproduce,steps to reproduce,ngā takahanga whakaputa anō
gloss.repro.text: Te whakaputa anō i tētahi pārurenga ā-hiahia mā te whai i ngā takahanga rite, kia taea ai te ako me te whakatika. Ko te tuhi i aua takahanga te wāhanga whai hua rawa o te pūrongo pārurenga.
gloss.severity.text: Te kino o te pānga o tētahi raru, mai i tētahi whakahōhā iti tae noa ki te tū o ngā mea katoa.
gloss.devops.text: He tikanga mahi e mahi ai te hunga hanga pūmanawa me te hunga whakahaere i taua pūmanawa hei rōpū kotahi, me te nui o te aunoa, kia whakaputaina ai ngā rerekētanga i ngā wā maha, i runga i te haumaru.
gloss.cicd.text: Ka whakakotahitia ngā rerekētanga a te katoa ki te putanga matua i ngā wā maha, ā, ka tirotirohia aunoatia i ia wā (continuous integration), kia rite tonu ai te pūmanawa ki te whakaputa mā te pēhi i te pātene kotahi (continuous delivery).
gloss.contdeploy.text: Kotahi te takahanga ki mua atu i te continuous delivery: ka puta aunoa ki te ora ia rerekētanga ka tutuki i ngā tirotiro, kāore he pātene hei pēhi.
gloss.pipeline.text: Te raupapa aunoa o ngā takahanga e haere ai tētahi rerekētanga i tōna ara ki te ora, pēnei i te hanga, te whakamātau, kātahi ka tuku.
gloss.environment.text: Kotahi te tārua wehe o te pūnaha mō tētahi take, pēnei i tētahi hei hanga, i tētahi hei whakamātau, me tērā e ora ana.
gloss.devenv.text: Te tārua e mahi ai te kaiwhakawhanake, i te nuinga o te wā kei tōna ake rorohiko, ā, mēnā ka pakaru ngā mea, kāore tētahi e pāngia.
gloss.testenv.text: He tārua wehe o te pūnaha e whakamahia ana mō te whakamātau anake, kia kore ai e pā ki te ratonga pono.
gloss.staging.text: Te tārua whakamutunga kua whakaritea kia ōrite ki te pūnaha ora, mō te tirotiro whakamutunga i mua i te whakaputanga o tētahi rerekētanga.
gloss.artifact.text: Te kōnae, te paihere rānei ka puta mai i tētahi hanga, kua rite hei penapena, hei tirotiro, hei whakaputa rānei.
gloss.hotfix.text: He whakatika ohorere ka whakaputaina tere, i waho i te mahere noa, nā te mea kua pakaru tētahi mea nui.
gloss.patch.text: He whakahōu iti e whakatika ana i tētahi pārurenga, e kati ana rānei i tētahi poka haumaru. He mea nui te tāuta tere i ngā papaki haumaru.
gloss.version.text: He tapanga pēnei i a 2.4.1 e kī ana ko tēhea te whakaputanga kei a koe. Te nuinga o te wā ka rerekē te tau tuatahi mō ngā rerekētanga nui, te tau whakamutunga mō ngā whakatika iti.
gloss.relnotes.text: He rārangi poto, māmā hoki o ngā mea i rerekē i roto i tētahi whakaputanga, mā te hunga e whakamahi ana, tae atu ki ngā whakatika me ngā here e mōhiotia ana. E kīia ana hoki he changelog.
gloss.flag.also: pere āhuatanga, feature flags,feature toggle,feature toggles
gloss.flag.text: He pana whakakā-whakaweto mō tētahi āhuatanga, kia puta huna ai te mahi hou ki te ora, ā, ka taea te whakakā (te whakaweto anō rānei) me te kore whakaputanga hou.
gloss.rollfwd.text: Te whakatika i tētahi whakaputanga kino mā te tuku tere i tētahi putanga hou kua whakatikatia, kaua e hoki ki te mea tawhito.
gloss.canary.text: Te tuku i tētahi rerekētanga ki tētahi rōpū iti i te tuatahi, ā, ki te katoa anake ina kitea he pai. I tapaina ki ngā kānari i kawea ki raro i te whenua e ngā kaikeri hei whakatūpato moata.
gloss.bluegreen.text: Te pupuri i ngā tārua e rua o te pūnaha ora, ā, ka huri i te tangata ki te mea hou i te wā kotahi, kia taea ai te hoki tonu mēnā ka hē.
gloss.zerodown.word: Whakaputa kāore he wā tū (Zero-downtime deployment)
gloss.zerodown.also: whakaputa kāore he wā tū, zero downtime,zero-downtime
gloss.zerodown.text: Te whakaputa i tētahi putanga hou me te kore e mutu te ratonga mō ōna kaiwhakamahi.
gloss.chgenable.text: Te āwhina i ngā rerekētanga kia angitu: te ine i te tūraru, te whiwhi i te whakaaetanga tika me te kōwhiri i tētahi wā pai. E kīia ana hoki he change management.
gloss.cab.word: Poari tohutohu rerekētanga (Change advisory board, CAB)
gloss.cab.text: He rōpū e tirotiro ana i ngā rerekētanga nui, ā, ka whakatau mēnā ka haere whakamua, āhea hoki.
gloss.stdchange.text: He rerekētanga tūraru iti ka mahia i te huarahi kotahi kua whakamātauhia i ia wā, nō reira kua whakaaetia i mua.
gloss.normchange.text: He rerekētanga me tirotiro, me whakaae i mua i tōna haere whakamua.
gloss.emergchange.text: He rerekētanga me puta tonu hei whakatika, hei ārai rānei i tētahi raru nui, me tētahi whakaaetanga tere ake e hāngai ana.
gloss.automation.text: Te whakarite kia mahia e te rorohiko tētahi mahi tukurua mā tōna anō, kia tere ake ai, kia ōrite ai hoki te mahi i ia wā.
gloss.infra.text: Ngā mīhini, ngā whatunga me ngā ratonga e rere ai te pūmanawa.
gloss.iac.word: Hanganga tūāpapa hei waehere (Infrastructure as code, IaC)
gloss.iac.text: Te whakaahua i ō tūmau me ō tautuhinga i roto i ngā kōnae e pupuritia ana i te taha o te waehere, kia taea ai te hanga anō kia rite tonu i ia wā.
gloss.cloud.text: Te reti rorohiko, rokiroki me ngā ratonga mai i tētahi kaiwhakarato nui mā te ipurangi, kaua ko ōu ake mīhini.
gloss.provider.text: He kamupene e reti ana i te kaha rorohiko mā te ipurangi, pēnei i a Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud rānei.
gloss.hosting.text: Te wāhi e noho ana, e rere ana tō taupānga, tō pae tukutuku rānei kia taea ai e te tangata te toro atu, i te nuinga o te wā ka retia mai i tētahi kamupene.
gloss.domain.text: Te wāhitau tukutuku e patopatohia ana e te tangata, pēnei i a example.com. Ka retia e koe ia tau, nō reira me whakahōu.
gloss.dns.text: He kupu poto mō domain name system: te pukapuka wāhitau o te ipurangi, ka huri i tētahi ingoa pēnei i a example.com hei wāhitau o te rorohiko tika.
gloss.container.text: He pūkete kua hiri e mau ana i tētahi taupānga me ngā mea katoa e hiahiatia ana e ia, kia ōrite tonu tana rere i runga i ngā rorohiko katoa. Ko Docker te taputapu e tino mōhiotia ana.
gloss.vm.text: He rorohiko pohewa e rere ana i roto i tētahi rorohiko tūturu, kia taea ai e tētahi mīhini nui te mahi hei mīhini maha.
gloss.serverless.text: Te whakahaere i te waehere me te kore e tiaki i ngā tūmau mā koe anō: ka whakahaere te kaiwhakarato ina hiahiatia, ā, ka utu koe mō tāu i whakamahi ai.
gloss.lb.text: Te mea e tohatoha ana i ngā manuhiri ki ngā tūmau maha, kia kore ai tētahi e taumaha rawa.
gloss.cache.text: He pātaka ngāwari o ngā hua o nā tata nei, ka puritia ki te taha, kia kore ai e tikina anō, e tātaihia anō rānei te mea kotahi. Mā te muku i a ia ka whakatika pea i ngā whārangi he āhua tawhito.
gloss.cdn.word: Whatunga tuku ihirangi (Content delivery network, CDN)
gloss.cdn.text: He huinga tūmau puta noa i te ao e pupuri ana i ngā tārua o ō whārangi me ō pikitia tata ki ō manuhiri, kia tere ai te utanga.
gloss.migration.text: Te nekeneke i ngā raraunga, i ngā pūnaha rānei mai i tētahi whirihora tawhito ki tētahi hou, te whakarerekē tūpato rānei i te whakatakotoranga o tētahi pātengi raraunga.
gloss.svcmgmt.text: Ngā mea katoa e pā ana ki te pupuri i tētahi ratonga kia whai hua, kia mahi hoki mō te hunga e whirinaki ana ki a ia, i ia rā, i ia rā.
gloss.itil.text: He aratohu e whakamahia whānuitia ana mō te whakahaere ratonga pai, e kapi ana i ngā mea pēnei i ngā aituā, ngā raru me ngā rerekētanga. I mua, ko te tikanga o te ingoa ko IT Infrastructure Library.
gloss.itsm.word: Whakahaere ratonga IT (IT service management, ITSM)
gloss.itsm.text: Te whakahaere i te hangarau hei ratonga mō te tangata, me ngā huarahi mārama hei whakahaere i ngā tono, ngā aituā, ngā rerekētanga me ngā whakapainga.
gloss.managed.text: He ratonga e whakahaerehia ana, e tiakina ana e tētahi atu mōu, i raro i tētahi whakaaetanga mō te pai o tana mahi.
gloss.svcowner.text: Te tangata e kawe ana i te kawenga mō tētahi ratonga katoa: te pai o tana mahi, te utu, me tana whakapai ake.
gloss.sla.word: Whakaaetanga taumata ratonga (Service level agreement, SLA)
gloss.sla.text: He oati tuhi ki ngā kiritaki mō te pai o te mahi a tētahi ratonga, pēnei i “e rere ana 99.9% o te wā”, i “ka whakautua i roto i te hāora kotahi” rānei, ā, i te nuinga o te wā ka whakahokia he moni mēnā ka takahia.
gloss.slo.word: Whāinga taumata ratonga (Service level objective, SLO)
gloss.slo.text: Te whāinga a te rōpū ake mō te pai o te mahi a tētahi ratonga i tētahi wā, i te nuinga o te wā ka whakaritea he paku kaha ake i te SLA hei haumaru.
gloss.sli.word: Tohu taumata ratonga (Service level indicator, SLI)
gloss.sli.text: Te inenga tūturu ka whakatauritea e koe ki tētahi whāinga, pēnei i te ōrau o ngā toro i pai te utanga.
gloss.uptimepct.also: wā e rere ana, uptime percentage
gloss.uptimepct.text: Te nui o te wā e mahi ana tētahi ratonga, hei ōrau i te nuinga o te wā. Ahakoa 99.9%, ka toe tonu kia 43 meneti pea te wā tū ia marama.
gloss.availability.text: Mēnā ka taea e te tangata te whakamahi i tētahi ratonga ina hiahiatia, e inea ana hei uptime i te nuinga o te wā.
gloss.downtime.text: Te wā kāore e mahi ana te ratonga, kua whakawetongia rānei, he mea whakarite, kāore rānei.
gloss.errorbudget.text: Te nui paku o te rahua e whakaaetia ana e tō whāinga pūmautanga. I te wā e toe ana, ka āhei koe ki te tūraru ki ngā rerekētanga; ina pau, ka āta haere koe.
gloss.outage.text: He wā e mutu ana te ratonga, e pakaru kino ana rānei mō ōna kaiwhakamahi.
gloss.degraded.also: kua heke te kounga, degraded service
gloss.degraded.text: E mahi ana, engari kāore i te pai: e pōturi ana, kāore rānei ētahi wāhanga e mahi.
gloss.monitoring.text: Te mātakitaki aunoa i tētahi ratonga i ngā wā katoa, kia kitea ai ngā raru, ko te mea pai, i mua i te kitenga a ngā kaiwhakamahi.
gloss.observability.also: te āhei ki te tirotiro, o11y
gloss.observability.text: Te kaha ki te mōhio he aha e haere ana i roto i tētahi pūnaha mai i waho, mā āna rātaka, āna tau me āna ara whai.
gloss.log.text: He rātaka haere tonu e tuhia ana e tētahi hōtaka mō āna mahi, e whakamahia ana hei mōhio he aha i hē ai.
gloss.trace.text: He rekoata o te haere a tētahi tono i roto i ngā wāhanga rerekē o tētahi pūnaha, takahanga ki te takahanga, e whakaatu ana i te wāhi i pōturi ai.
gloss.latency.text: Te roa e whakautu ai tētahi mea, pēnei i te tatari i waenga i te pātō me te puta mai o te whārangi.
gloss.alert.text: He karere aunoa e kī ana me aro tētahi mea, pēnei i te pae tukutuku kāore e whakautu.
gloss.alertfatigue.text: Ina maha rawa ngā whakatūpato, ka tīmata te tangata ki te whakahawea i a rātou, tae atu ki ērā e hira ana.
gloss.dashboard.text: He mata e whakaatu ana i ngā tau me ngā āhuatanga matua i te kitenga kotahi.
gloss.paging.text: Te waea ohorere, te whakaoho rānei i te tangata e tūtei ana mō tētahi raru.
gloss.escalation.text: Te kawe mai i tētahi he nui ake ōna pūkenga, tōna mana rānei, ina kore e taea te whakatika i te raru i te taumata o nāianei, kāore rānei i te tere.
gloss.triage.text: Te kōmiri tere i ngā take e tae mai ana i runga i te ohorere me te hira, kia whakahaerehia tuatahitia te mea kino rawa.
gloss.impact.text: Te nui o te pānga o tētahi mea ki ngā tāngata: tokohia, ā, pēhea te kino.
gloss.urgency.text: Te hohoro me whakahaere tētahi mea. Mā te pānga me te ohorere tahi e whakatau te whakaarotau.
gloss.plevels.text: Ngā tapanga e whakaatu ana i te ohorere o tētahi take. Ko P1 te mea tino kino, me mahi tonu.
gloss.queue.text: Te rārangi o ngā tono me ngā aituā e tatari ana kia tangohia.
gloss.tiers.word: Rārangi tuatahi me te rārangi tuarua (First line, second line)
gloss.tiers.text: Ngā taumata tautoko: ka whakautu te rārangi tuatahi i te waea, ka whakatika i ngā mea māmā; he pūkenga hōhonu ake kei te rārangi tuarua mō ngā mea uaua. E kīia ana hoki he tier 1, he tier 2.
gloss.ic.text: Te tangata kotahi e ārahi ana i te urupare ki tētahi aituā, kia mōhio ai te katoa ko wai te kaiwhakatau, ko wai hoki e mahi ana i te aha.
gloss.responsetime.text: Te roa tae noa ki te tango tuatahi a tētahi i tētahi tono, aituā rānei.
gloss.resolution.also: wā whakatika, resolution times,time to resolve
gloss.resolution.text: Te roa ki te whakatika katoa i tētahi tono, aituā rānei, mai i te pūrongo tae noa ki te otinga.
gloss.mttr.word: Wā toharite hei whakaora anō (Mean time to recover, MTTR)
gloss.mttr.text: Hei toharite, te roa ki te whakahoki i tētahi ratonga kia mahi anō i muri i tana pakaru. He paku rerekē pea te tikanga o te MTTR, nō reira me kī he aha tāu e ine ana.
gloss.mtbf.word: Wā toharite i waenga i ngā rahua (Mean time between failures, MTBF)
gloss.mtbf.text: Hei toharite, te roa e rere ai tētahi ratonga i mua i te pakaru o tētahi mea.
gloss.cmdb.word: Pātengi raraunga whirihora (Configuration management database, CMDB)
gloss.cmdb.text: Te rārangi o ō tūemi whirihora katoa me te hono o tētahi ki tētahi, kia kitea ai he aha e whirinaki ana ki te aha.
gloss.asset.text: Tētahi mea whai uara kei a koe, e utua ana rānei hei whakahaere i te ratonga, pēnei i tētahi rorohiko pōnaho, i tētahi raihana pūmanawa, i tētahi ingoa rohe rānei.
gloss.capplan.text: Te whakarite kia rawaka te kaha rorohiko, te rokiroki me ngā tāngata mō ngā mea e haere mai ana.
gloss.scaling.also: te whakawhānui, scale up,scale out,scaling up,scaling out
gloss.scaling.text: Te manaaki i ngā kaiwhakamahi maha ake mā te hoatu i te kaha ake ki tētahi mīhini (scaling up), mā te tāpiri rānei i ētahi atu mīhini (scaling out).
gloss.bcp.word: Te haere tonu o te pakihi (Business continuity)
gloss.bcp.also: te haere tonu o te pakihi, business continuity plan
gloss.bcp.text: Ngā mahere hei pupuri i ngā mea nui kia haere tonu ina tino hē tētahi mea nui, pēnei i te ngaro o tētahi tari, o tētahi kaiwhakarato matua, o ngā rorohiko rānei.
gloss.dr.word: Whakaoranga i te aituā nui (Disaster recovery, DR)
gloss.dr.also: whakaoranga i te aituā nui, disaster recovery
gloss.dr.text: Te mahere me ngā taputapu hei whakahoki mai i tētahi ratonga i muri i tētahi mea tino kino, pēnei i te ngaro o tētahi pokapū raraunga katoa.
gloss.rto.word: Whāinga wā whakaora (Recovery time objective, RTO)
gloss.rto.text: Te roa rawa e āhei ai tētahi ratonga kia tū i muri i tētahi aituā nui, i mua i te wā me mahi anō.
gloss.rpo.word: Whāinga tohu whakaora (Recovery point objective, RPO)
gloss.rpo.text: Te nui o ngā raraunga hou ka taea e koe te ngaro, e inea ana hei wā. Ki te kotahi hāora te RPO, me tārua ia hāora i te iti rawa.
gloss.redundancy.text: Te whai i ngā mea tuarua kua rite, pēnei i tētahi tūmau tuarua, kia kore ai e mutu te ratonga i te rahua kotahi.
gloss.failover.also: whakawhiti ki te tuarua, fail over
gloss.failover.text: Te huri ki tētahi pūnaha tuarua mā tōna anō ina rahua te mea noa.
gloss.spof.word: Wāhi rahua kotahi (Single point of failure)
gloss.spof.also: wāhi rahua kotahi, single points of failure,SPOF
gloss.spof.text: Te wāhanga kotahi ka hinga ngā mea katoa i a ia ina pakaru, nā te mea kāore he tuarua.
gloss.maintwin.text: He wā kua whakaritea e tārewa ai pea te ratonga, e pōturi ai rānei, mō te tiaki; ka whakamōhiotia ngā kaiwhakamahi i mua.
gloss.handover.text: Te tuku i te mahi, i te mātauranga me te kawenga ki tētahi atu tangata, rōpū rānei, kia kore ai tētahi mea e taka.
gloss.kb.text: He kohinga tuhinga āwhina me ngā whakautu, mō ngā kaiwhakamahi me te rōpū.
gloss.csat.word: Te makona o te kiritaki (Customer satisfaction, CSAT)
gloss.csat.text: He kaute mai i ngā kaiwhakamahi e kī ana i te nui o tō rātou koa, e pātaihia ana i te nuinga o te wā i muri i te katinga o tētahi tono.
gloss.supplier.text: He kamupene o waho e whirinaki ana koe ki a ia, pēnei i tō kaiwhakarato manaaki tūmau. E kīia ana hoki he vendor, he third party rānei.
gloss.retire.also: te whakamutu ratonga, retiring a service
gloss.retire.text: Te whakaweto pūmau i tētahi ratonga i runga i te haumaru: te kōrero ki ōna kaiwhakamahi, te whakahaere i ōna raraunga me ōna urunga, me te whakamutu i ōna utu.
gloss.eol.text: Ina kore te hua e whiwhi whakahōu, tautoko rānei mai i tōna kaihanga, nō reira me whakakapi.
gloss.cybersec.text: Te tiaki i ngā pūnaha me ngā raraunga kei urutomohia, kei tāhaetia, kei whakangaromia rānei.
gloss.authn.text: Te tirotiro ko wai tētahi, i te nuinga o te wā mā te kupuhipa, mā te waehere rānei. E poatohia ana hei authn.
gloss.authz.text: Te tirotiro he aha ngā mea e whakaaetia ana kia mahia e tētahi, ina mōhio koe ko wai ia. E poatohia ana hei authz.
gloss.mfa.text: Te takiuru mā ngā taunakitanga e rua, neke atu rānei, pēnei i te kupuhipa me tētahi waehere i tō waea. E kīia ana hoki he two-factor (2FA).
gloss.sso.text: Te takiuru kotahi hei uru ki ngā pūnaha maha, pēnei i te whakamahi i tō pūkete mahi ki ngā wāhi katoa.
gloss.pwmgr.text: He taupānga e hanga ana i ngā kupuhipa kaha, e maumahara ana hoki mōu.
gloss.secret.text: He kupuhipa, he kī, he waehere muna atu rānei ka whakamahia e tētahi hōtaka hei uru ki tētahi mea. Kaua rawa e tiritiria, e tuhia rānei ki te waehere.
gloss.apikey.text: He waehere muna e āhei ai tētahi hōtaka ki te whakamahi i te API a tētahi atu ratonga, e whakaatu ana hoki ko wai e whakamahi ana (e utu ana hoki).
gloss.accesstoken.text: He tohu urunga mō te wā poto e whakaatu ana kua whakaaetia te hōtaka kia uru, kia kore ai e hiahiatia tō kupuhipa i ia wā. Ehara i te rite ki te tohu AI (token).
gloss.encryption.text: Te whakapōrearea i ngā mōhiohio kia pānuitia ai e te tangata anake kei a ia te kī tika.
gloss.https.text: Te huarahi haumaru e haere ai ngā whārangi tukutuku, e kitea ana mā te raka iti i tō pūtirotiro, kia kore ai e taea e tētahi i waenganui te pānui, te whakarerekē rānei.
gloss.cert.text: He kāri tuakiri matihiko e whakaatu ai tētahi pae tukutuku ko wai ia, ā, e āhei ai ki te whakamahi i a HTTPS. Ka pau tōna wā, nō reira me whakahōu.
gloss.permissions.text: Ngā ture mō wai e āhei ana ki te kite, ki te whakarerekē rānei i te aha.
gloss.leastpriv.also: mana iti rawa, principle of least privilege
gloss.leastpriv.text: Te hoatu ki ia tangata, hōtaka rānei te urunga e tino hiahiatia ana anake, mō te roa e hiahiatia ana anake.
gloss.rbac.word: Whakahaere urunga i runga i te tūranga (Role-based access control, RBAC)
gloss.rbac.text: Te hoatu i te urunga i runga i te tūranga, pēnei i te kaimātakitaki, i te kaiwhakatika rānei, kaua tangata ki te tangata.
gloss.vuln.text: He ngoikoretanga ka taea e tētahi te whakamahi hei uru kino, hei whakakino rānei.
gloss.zeroday.text: He ngoikoretanga e mōhiotia ana e ngā kaiwhakaeke i mua i te whai wā o ngā kaihanga ki te whakatika.
gloss.malware.text: He pūmanawa kino, pēnei i ngā huaketo, i hangaia hei whakangaro, hei tūtei, hei tāhae rānei.
gloss.ransomware.text: He pūmanawa kino e raka ana i ō kōnae, ā, e tono moni ana hei wewete. Ko ngā kape tiaki pai te ārai pai rawa.
gloss.phishing.text: Ngā karere teka e ngana ana ki te tinihanga i a koe kia tuku kupuhipa, moni rānei, kia whakatuwhera rānei i tētahi mea kino.
gloss.socialeng.text: Te tinihanga i ngā tāngata, kaua i ngā rorohiko, kia hoatu e rātou he urunga, pēnei i tētahi waea teka mai i “te tautoko IT”.
gloss.firewall.text: He kaitiaki e whakatau ana ko ēhea raraunga whatunga e āhei ana ki te uru mai, ki te puta atu rānei.
gloss.vpn.text: He kupu poto mō virtual private network: he hononga muna, kua whakamunatia, mā te ipurangi, e whakamahia ana hei uru haumaru ki ngā pūnaha mahi.
gloss.ddos.word: Te aukati ratonga (Denial of service, DoS, DDoS)
gloss.ddos.text: Te waipuke i tētahi ratonga ki te nui rawa o ngā tono teka kia kore ai e taea e ngā tāngata tūturu te whakamahi. Ko te tikanga o DDoS, ka ahu mai i ngā rorohiko maha i te wā kotahi.
gloss.pentest.text: Te utu i ngā tohunga pai kia ngana ki te uru, kia kitea ai ngā ngoikoretanga i mua i te kitenga a ngā kaiwhakaeke tūturu.
gloss.audit.text: He tirotiro tūpato mō te pai o te tiaki i tētahi mea, e whakatauritea ana ki tētahi rārangi tikanga pai.
gloss.threatmodel.also: te whakatauira mōrearea, threat model,threat modeling
gloss.threatmodel.text: Te āta whakaaro ko wai pea ka whakaeke i tētahi mea, me pēhea, ā, he aha tāu e mahi ai hei aukati i a rātou.
gloss.breach.text: Ina rere ngā mōhiohio muna ki te hunga kāore e tika kia whiwhi, ina ngaro rānei, ina whakarerekētia rānei me te kore whakaaetanga.
gloss.pii.text: Ngā mōhiohio mō tētahi tangata ka taea te tautohu, pēnei i te ingoa, i te wāhitau īmēra, i te wāhi rānei. E kīia ana hoki he PII.
gloss.gdpr.text: Te ture a Ūropi mō ngā raraunga whaiaro (he putanga ake tō Piritene): kohia ngā mea e hiahiatia ana anake, kia haumaru te pupuri, ā, tukua te tangata kia kite, kia muku rānei i ōna ake raraunga.
gloss.dataprot.text: Te tiaki tika i ngā raraunga whaiaro i raro i te ture.
gloss.privacypolicy.also: kaupapahere noho muna, privacy statement,privacy notice
gloss.privacypolicy.text: He whārangi tūmatanui e kī ana he aha ngā raraunga whaiaro e kohia ana e koe, he aha te take, me tāu e mahi ai ki aua raraunga.
gloss.consent.text: Te “āe” mārama, herekore o te tangata kia whakamahia ōna raraunga i tētahi tikanga motuhake. Ka taea e ia te tango atu i ngā wā katoa.
gloss.cookie.text: He kōnae iti ka penapenatia e tētahi pae tukutuku ki tō pūtirotiro hei maumahara i ētahi mea, pēnei i tō takiuru. Mō ētahi, me whakaae koe i te tuatahi.
gloss.minimisation.text: Te kohi me te pupuri i ngā raraunga whaiaro e tino hiahiatia ana anake mō te mahi.
gloss.retention.text: Te roa e pupuritia ai ngā raraunga i mua i te mukunga. Ko te kore e pupuri roa ake i te wā e hiahiatia ana he haumaru ake, ā, he ture hoki i te nuinga o te wā.
gloss.anon.text: Te whakarerekē i ngā raraunga kia kore ai e taea te tautohu i tētahi tangata i aua raraunga.
gloss.pseudo.text: Te whakakapi i ngā ingoa me ētahi atu taipitopito ki ngā waehere, me tētahi kī e puritia wehe ana hei hono anō. He raraunga whaiaro tonu ēnei.
gloss.dpa.word: Whakaaetanga tukatuka raraunga (Data processing agreement, DPA)
gloss.dpa.text: He kirimana e kī ana me pēhea e whakahaere ai te kaiwhakarato i ngā raraunga whaiaro hei mahi mōu.
gloss.dpia.word: Aromatawai pānga tiaki raraunga (Data protection impact assessment, DPIA)
gloss.dpia.text: He tirohanga tūpato i mua i te tīmata, mō te pānga o tētahi mahere whakamahi raraunga whaiaro ki ngā tāngata, me te āhua o te whakaiti i ngā tūraru.
gloss.auditlog.text: He rekoata o te mahi a wai, he aha, āhea hoki, kia taea ai te tirotiro i ngā mahi a muri ake.
gloss.compliance.also: te whai i ngā ture, compliant
gloss.compliance.text: Te whai i ngā ture, ngā ture ā-tikanga me ngā paerewa e pā ana ki a koe, me te āhei ki te whakaatu e pērā ana koe.
gloss.iso.text: He paerewa ao rongonui mō te whakahaere i te haumaru mōhiohio. Ka taea e ngā kamupene te whiwhi tiwhikete i raro i a ia.
gloss.soc.text: He pūrongo Amerika, kua tirohia e ngā kaitātari o waho, e whakaatu ana e tiaki tika ana te kamupene i ngā raraunga kiritaki.
gloss.ai.text: Ngā pūnaha rorohiko e mahi ana i ngā mea e whakaaro ana tātou me he tangata hei mahi, pēnei i te tuhi, te whakautu pātai, te tautohu pikitia rānei.
gloss.ml.word: Te ako a te mīhini (Machine learning, ML)
gloss.ml.also: te ako a te mīhini, machine learning
gloss.ml.text: He tikanga e ako ai ngā rorohiko i ngā hanga auau mai i ngā tauira tini, kaua ko te hoatu ture tōtika ki a rātou.
gloss.model.text: Te “roro” kua whakangungua o tētahi pūnaha AI, i hangaia mā te ako i ngā tauira tino maha. He rerekē ngā tauira i te pūkenga, i te tere, i te utu hoki.
gloss.llm.word: Tauira reo nui (Large language model, LLM)
gloss.llm.text: He tauira AI i whakangungua ki te nui rawa o ngā kuputuhi, nō reira ka taea e ia te pānui me te tuhi i te reo.
gloss.genai.text: He AI e waihanga ana i ngā mea hou, pēnei i te kuputuhi, i ngā pikitia, i te waehere rānei, kaua ko te kōmaka, te kite noa rānei.
gloss.chatbot.text: He hōtaka ka kōrero koe ki a ia i te reo o ia rā, mā te patopato, mā te kōrero rānei.
gloss.prompt.text: Te mea e hoatu ana e koe ki te AI: tō pātai, ō tohutohu rānei, me ngā mea katoa ka hoatu e koe. Ko ngā tohutohu mārama ake ka whiwhi whakautu pai ake i te nuinga o te wā.
gloss.prompteng.text: Te pūkenga ki te tuhi tohutohu e puta ai he hua pono, he hua whai take.
gloss.sysprompt.also: tohutohu pūnaha, system prompts,system instruction,system instructions
gloss.sysprompt.text: Ngā tohutohu papamuri ka whiwhi te AI i mua i te tīmatanga o te kōrerorero, e whakatau ana i tōna tūranga me ōna ture. He nui ake tō rātou mana i tāu e patopato ai.
gloss.context.text: Ngā mea katoa ka kitea e te AI i a ia e mahi ana: ngā tohutohu, ō karere, ngā kōnae kua pānuitia e ia me ngā whakautu o mua.
gloss.ctxwin.text: Te nui ka taea e te AI te pupuri i te hinengaro i te wā kotahi, e inea ana hei tohu (token). Ki te nui atu, ka whakarerea, ka whakarāpopototia rānei ngā wāhanga tawhito.
gloss.session.text: Kotahi te kōrerorero mahi me te AI, mai i te tīmatanga ki te mutunga. Ka tīmata te nohoanga hou me te maumahara ātea.
gloss.memory.text: Ngā tuhipoka ka puritia e te AI i waenga i ngā nohoanga, kia mahara ai ia ki ō hiahia me ngā whakatau o mua.
gloss.hallucination.text: Ina kī te AI i tētahi mea me te āhua tino māia, engari he mea hanga noa, he hē rānei. Tirohia ngā meka hira.
gloss.training.text: Te whakaako i tētahi tauira mā te whakaatu i ngā tauira tino maha ki a ia, i mua i te whakamahinga e tētahi.
gloss.trainingdata.text: Ngā tauira i ako ai te tauira AI. Ka mutu tōna mōhio i te rā i kohia ai aua raraunga.
gloss.cutoff.text: Te rā ka mutu te mōhio kua hangaia ki roto i te AI. Kāore ia e mōhio ki ngā mea o muri mai, ki te kore ia e rapu.
gloss.finetune.text: Te whakangungu tāpiri i tētahi tauira kua oti kē ki ō ake tauira, kia pai ake ai ia ki tētahi mahi motuhake.
gloss.inference.text: Ka whakamahia tūturutia te tauira AI hei whakautu i tētahi mea, kaua ko te whakangungu.
gloss.tooluse.also: whakamahi taputapu, tool calling,tool call,tool calls
gloss.tooluse.text: Te āhei o te AI ki te mahi i ngā mea, kaua e kōrero noa: whakahaere i ngā whakahau, pānui kōnae, rapu tukutuku rānei, mā ngā taputapu ka hoatu e te taupānga.
gloss.subagent.text: He AI āwhina ka hoatu e tētahi AI matua he mahi iti ake ki a ia, ā, ka whakahokia mai e ia te hua.
gloss.multiagent.text: He maha ngā AI e mahi tahi ana i tētahi mahi kotahi, he wāhanga tō ia AI, pēnei i tētahi rōpū iti.
gloss.autonomy.text: Te nui o ngā mea ka taea e te AI te mahi mā tōna anō i mua i tana pātai ki tētahi tangata.
gloss.hitl.word: Te tangata i roto i te porowhita (Human in the loop)
gloss.hitl.also: te tangata i roto i te porowhita, human-in-the-loop,HITL
gloss.hitl.text: Te whakauru tonu i tētahi tangata hei tirotiro, hei whakaae rānei i ngā mahi a te AI i ngā wā matua. I roto i a AI-gile, ko koe tērā.
gloss.guardrails.text: Ngā here me ngā tirotiro e pupuri ana i ngā mahi a te AI kia haumaru, pēnei i te whakaaetanga e hiahiatia ana i mua i te haere ora o tētahi mea. Ka whakaiti i te tūraru o ngā hapa, engari kāore e whakakore katoa.
gloss.rag.text: Te tuku i te AI kia rapu i roto i ō ake tuhinga i mua i te whakautu, kia tū ai āna whakautu ki runga i ō meka.
gloss.embedding.text: Te huri i te kuputuhi hei rārangi tau e mau ana i tōna tikanga, kia kitea ai e te rorohiko ngā mea he rite te tikanga.
gloss.vectordb.also: pātengi raraunga vector, vector databases,vector store
gloss.vectordb.text: He pātengi raraunga i hangaia hei rapu i aua rārangi tau (embeddings), hei kimi i ngā mea he rite te tikanga.
gloss.mcp.word: Kawa horopaki tauira (Model Context Protocol, MCP)
gloss.mcp.text: He tikanga paerewa hei hono i ngā taputapu me ngā puna raraunga ki ngā taupānga AI, kia taea e te AI te whakamahi.
gloss.temperature.text: He tautuhinga mō te māia o ngā whakautu a te AI. Ko te iti ka hoatu he whakautu pūmau ake, māmā ake te matapae; ko te teitei ka hoatu he whakautu rerekē ake. Ahakoa iti, ahakoa teitei, kāore e tika tonu ai ia.
gloss.multimodal.text: Ka taea te mahi ki ngā momo mōhiohio maha, pēnei i te kuputuhi, i ngā pikitia me te oro.
gloss.evals.text: He whakamātau kua whakaritea mō te pai o te mahi a te AI ki ngā tauira kua tīpakohia, kia whakatauritea ai ngā tauira, ngā prompt rānei.
gloss.bias.text: Ina tītaha tētahi AI (he tangata rānei) ki tētahi taha, kāore i te tika, i te nuinga o te wā nā ngā mea i ako ai ia.
gloss.responsible.text: Te whakamahi i te AI i runga i te tika, te haumaru me te pono, ā, ko te tangata tonu te haepapa mō ngā hua.
gloss.injection.text: He tinihanga e ngana ai ngā tohutohu huna i tētahi whārangi tukutuku, i tētahi kōnae rānei, kia mahia e te AI tētahi mea kāore i tonoa e tōna kaiwhakamahi.
gloss.ratelimit.text: He tepe mō te maha o ngā tono ka tukuna ki tētahi ratonga i tētahi wā kua whakaritea. Ki te neke atu, me tatari koe.
gloss.usagelimit.text: Te nui o te mahi AI e whakaaetia ana e tō mahere i tētahi wā; i muri, ka tārewa, ka nui ake rānei te utu.
gloss.vibe.text: Te hanga pūmanawa, te nuinga mā te whakamārama i tāu e hiahia ana ki te AI, ā, mā te AI e tuhi te waehere.
gloss.budget.text: Te nui o te moni kua wehea mō tētahi mea.
gloss.costest.text: He matapae pai rawa mō te utu o tētahi mea i mua i te tīmata.
gloss.roi.word: Hua whakahoki haumi (Return on investment, ROI)
gloss.roi.text: Te mea ka hoki mai ki a koe ina whakatauritea ki tāu i whakapau ai. Mēnā he tōrunga, i whai take.
gloss.tco.word: Utu tapeke o te pupuri (Total cost of ownership, TCO)
gloss.tco.text: Te utu tūturu katoa o tētahi mea puta noa i tōna oranga, kaua ko te utu hoko anake: te whakahaere, te tautoko, ngā whakahōunga, ā, hei whakamutunga, te whakamutu.
gloss.capex.text: Ko CapEx te moni e whakapaua ana i te tīmatanga mō ngā mea e pupuri ana koe; ko OpEx te whakapaunga haere tonu, pēnei i ngā nama ia marama.
gloss.subscription.text: Te utu auau, i te nuinga o te wā ia marama, ia tau rānei, kia whakamahi tonu ai i tētahi mea.
gloss.saas.word: Pūmanawa hei ratonga (Software as a service, SaaS)
gloss.saas.text: Te pūmanawa e whakamahia ana e koe ki runga ipurangi, ā, e utua ana mā te ohaurunga, ā, mā te kaihanga e whakahaere mōu.
gloss.payg.word: Utu i tāu e whakamahi ai (Pay as you go)
gloss.payg.also: utu i tāu e whakamahi ai, pay-as-you-go,usage-based pricing
gloss.payg.text: Te utu mō tāu i whakamahi ai anake, pēnei i te rorohiko kapua, i ngā tohu AI rānei.
gloss.overage.text: Te whakamahi neke atu i ngā mea kei roto i tō mahere, ā, ka nui ake pea te utu.

sample.inc.d: He mea waihanga noa, hei whakaharatau. Ka kite ngā manuhiri e whakatuwhera ana i te hono RSVP i te "Kua hē tētahi mea", nā reira kāore he tangata e taea te kī ka tae mai. Whāia ngā hipanga 🎓 Whakamātauria i tēnei kāri: kāore he mea tūturu e pakaru, kāore hoki he AI e whakamahia.
sample.inc.say: Tokotoru ngā manuhiri i tuku karere: mai i te ata nei e kī ana te whārangi RSVP "Kua hē tētahi mea".
sample.inc.major: 🚨 Whakaharatau: he aitua nui tēnei ināianei. I tētahi ratonga tūturu ka ara te kāhui, ka whakaohongia te kaimahi on-call, ā, ka tae mai ki a koe kotahi te pānui. I konei kāore tētahi e whakaohongia. Ā muri: whakatikahia, ka kati i te kāri.

sample.inc.rbgo: 📖 Whakaharatau: i tētahi kaupapa tūturu ka tiakina tēnei runbook ināianei hei {file} ki te kōpaki o te kaupapa. Kāore he kōpaki o te tauira, nō reira kāore he mea i tuhia.
gloss.ci.text: He mea kotahi e whakawhirinaki ana tō ratonga ki runga, pēnei i te tūmau, te rohe, te tiwhikete, te kī, te kaiwhakarato rānei. Ka whakarārangitia e 🗂️ Ngā taonga whirihoranga mō ia ratonga, kia kite koe he aha e pāngia ana e tētahi aitua, he aha me whakahou, me kape tiaki rānei.
gloss.expiry.text: Te rā ka mutu te mahi o tētahi mea ki te kore e whakahōungia, pēnei i te tiwhikete haumaru o tētahi pae tukutuku, i tōna wāhitau tukutuku rānei. Ka mātakitaki a AI-gile i ēnei rā, ā, ka hanga kāri kotahi hei whakahōu i ia tētahi 30 rā i mua, kia kore ai e mutu ohorere tētahi mea.
gloss.desk.text: Te wāhi e tae mai ai ngā pātai me ngā pūrongo a te hunga e whakamahi ana i tō ratonga. Ka whakarōpūhia e AI-gile ia mea hei tono, hei aitua, hei whakaaro rānei, ā, ka kī mēnā he rite ki tētahi mea kua oti kē te pūrongo.
gloss.svcrequest.text: He tangata e tono ana i tētahi mea noa, pēnei i tētahi pūkete hou, i tētahi āwhina iti rānei, kaua ko te pūrongo kua pakaru tētahi mea. Ka tatari ki tōna wā; ko te aitua te tuatahi.
gloss.svcreview.also: ngā arotake ratonga,arotake ā-marama,ngā arotake ā-marama
gloss.svcreview.text: He titiro whakamuri ki te marama kotahi o tētahi ratonga: ngā aitua i tuwhera, i whakatikahia, te tere o te whakautu ki te tangata, te wā e mahi ana, me ngā tohu i whakamahia. Ka whakaaturia e te Arotake ā-marama mō ia ratonga.
gloss.accessreview.text: Te tirotiro ia 90 rā ko wai e āhei tonu ana ki te uru: ngā hononga tiritiri, ngā tūranga o ngā hoa me ngā kupuhipa me ngā kī kua penapenahia. Ka pupuri, ka tango rānei koe i ia tētahi, kia kore ai e noho tonu te urunga tawhito.
gloss.improvements.text: Ngā mea katoa i whakatau te rōpū kia pai ake, i te wāhi kotahi: ngā whakaaro retro, ngā mahi arotake me ngā whakatika raruraru, me te tūnga o ia mea. Kei raro i 📈 Whakapainga.
gloss.tokencap.text: He tepe ā-marama mō ngā tohu e whakaaetia ana kia whakamahia e ngā kaiwhakahaere o tētahi ratonga. Ka tae ki te 80% ka whiwhi koe i tētahi whakatūpato; ka tae ki te 100% ka tatari ā rātou mahi o muri ki te marama e heke mai, kia whakapikia rānei e koe te tepe.

dc.guide.2.html: Whakatuwherahia Bot i te tahua mauī, kātahi ko Reset Token ka tārua. Kotahi anake te wā e whakaaturia ana.

dc.guide.4.html: Whakapiria te tohu ki raro, kōwhiria ko wai e kōrero ai te pot, ka pēhi i Tiaki.
